jobs.title: Product Owner, Supply Chain & Procurement
jobs.excerpt: As a Product Owner, Supply Chain & Procurement (Business Solutions – Corporate Core Finance), you will own the vision, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for SAP S/4HANA capabilities that support procurement, inventory, and related finance processes.
jobs.description:
As a Product Owner, Supply Chain & Procurement (Business Solutions – Corporate Core Finance), you will own the vision, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for SAP S/4HANA capabilities that support procurement, inventory, and related finance processes. You will work closely with business stakeholders, SAP functional teams, engineers, QA, data teams, and delivery partners to deliver scalable, user-centered solutions across procure-to-pay and connected order-to-cash workflows.

This role combines strong product ownership with a working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Materials Management, Sales and Distribution, and Finance/Controlling integrations. You will focus on improving business outcomes such as purchasing compliance, process efficiency, invoice automation, spend visibility, inventory accuracy, financial controls, and user experience.

Drive Product Outcomes

  • Own, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog for supply chain, procurement, and related finance capabilities.
  • Define the customer and business problems to solve, desired outcomes, and success measures—not only the features to deliver.
  • Translate business objectives into prioritized epics, user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria, and incremental release plans.
  • Balance customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, risk, compliance needs, and delivery timelines.
  • Break large initiatives into smaller releases that enable continuous delivery, learning, and measurable improvement.
  • Define and monitor key performance indicators for adoption, process efficiency, procurement compliance, spend visibility, inventory accuracy, and user satisfaction.

Lead Discovery and Process Design

  • Lead discovery and requirements-gathering sessions with procurement, supply chain, finance, warehouse, sales, customer service, and IT stakeholders.
  • Understand current-state workflows, pain points, and control requirements needs across procure-to-pay and connected order-to-cash processes.
  • Facilitate future-state process design, identify gaps and dependencies, document decisions, and build alignment on scope and priorities.
  • Use stakeholder feedback, operational data, and system insights to validate assumptions before significant investment.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows through SAP capabilities, process simplification, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of core procurement, inventory, finance, and cross-functional business processes.

Enable Strong Delivery

  • Partner with SAP functional consultants, engineers, QA, integration teams, data teams, and business process owners to refine solutions and remove ambiguity.
  • Define requirements for integrations among SAP S/4HANA MM, SD, FI/CO, warehouse operations, tax, payment, logistics, customer, supplier, and third-party systems.
  • Validate end-to-end business and accounting impacts across requisition-to-payment, inventory, sales-order-to-billing, and financial reporting processes.
  • Participate in and lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, retrospectives, and other Agile delivery ceremonies.
  • Prioritize defects, enhancements, and change requests based on business impact, urgency, risk, compliance, and roadmap value.
  • Support implementation activities including master-data readiness, data migration, testing, cutover planning, release readiness, hypercare, and post-launch stabilization.
  • Coordinate business testing by defining test scenarios, test data, acceptance criteria, and success measures for end-to-end processes.
  • Support system integration testing, user acceptance testing, regression testing, defect triage, and business sign-off.

Build Alignment and Trust

  • Act as the liaison between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
  • Communicate product strategy, roadmap priorities, progress, trade-offs, risks, and dependencies clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Maintain organized product documentation, business-process materials, requirements, decisions, and release information in Confluence.
  • Use Jira and Slack effectively to manage backlog transparency, delivery workflow, stakeholder communication, and issue resolution.
  • Support change management through training materials, process documentation, release communications, stakeholder demonstrations, and adoption feedback.
  • Build trusted relationships across Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Technology, and external implementation partners.
  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Finance, Supply Chain, Business, or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, SAP functional delivery professional, or similar role in a technology-driven organization.
  • Experience owning and prioritizing a product backlog in an Agile delivery environment.
  • Experience delivering SAP S/4HANA procure-to-pay, materials management, inventory, finance integration, or related enterprise capabilities.
  • Strong knowledge of procurement processes, including requisitioning, purchasing, approvals, receiving, inventory, invoice verification, supplier management, and payment workflows.
  • Working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA MM and FI/CO integration concepts; familiarity with SAP SD and order-to-cash processes preferred.
  • Experience supporting SAP implementations, including testing, data migration, cutover, or post-go-live stabilization.
  • Experience collaborating with engineering, QA, design, data, integration, and SAP functional teams.
  • Effective stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Comfortable working with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong ability to write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and business requirements.
  • Strong presentation, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly detail-oriented with excellent organizational, prioritization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong judgment in managing priorities, resources, risks, dependencies, and delivery trade-offs.
  • Experience using Jira, Confluence, and Slack.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience with SAP SD configuration and integration concepts, including order-to-cash, pricing, billing, customer master data, and financial postings.
  • Familiarity with SAP MM configuration concepts, including purchasing organizations, plants, storage locations, purchasing documents, release strategies, invoice tolerances, and movement types.
  • Experience in media or entertainment
  • Ability to investigate and learn unfamiliar systems quickly.
  • Experience applying automation, analytics, or AI capabilities to improve finance, procurement, supply chain, or business workflows.

jobs.excerpt: About DoitWe are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more.
jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Location

Our GTM Systems Engineer will be an integral part of our Enterprise Systems team. This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, or Sweden. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal.

The OpportunityWe're looking for an engineering-minded owner of the systems our Sales, Marketing and Revenue Operations teams run on: CRM, marketing automation, CPQ and the tools around them. This is not a ticket-queue role. Business teams will bring you solutions ("add a field", "build me a report"). Your job is to find the problem behind the request and see how a change affects every connected system. Then fix it once, ideally so the next person can do it themselves without filing a request. You'll have an internal engineering team to lean on, and you'll use AI tools daily to build faster.

Responsibilities

  • Own the GTM systems as one connected whole: know how CRM, CPQ, marketing automation and sales-engagement tools share data, and design every change with that in view.
  • Turn requests into problems: ask what the business is trying to solve, propose options, explain trade-offs, and say "no" or "not like that" when it's the right call.
  • Remove recurring manual work: measure the effort, then replace it with automation or self-service tools that business users run themselves.
  • Build automations, small tools and integrations, choosing the simplest approach that will hold up.
  • Keep the data model lean and trustworthy: retire unused fields and legacy workarounds, and enforce data quality where data enters rather than cleaning it up later.
  • Keep integrations reliable: use native connectors where they do the job; where something custom is needed, respect API limits, add error handling and monitoring, and keep sandbox and production consistent. Collaborate with our internal engineering team as necessary.
  • Use AI tools to build, investigate issues, and speed up routine work.
  • Provide EMEA-hours support for the GTM stack, and use what you see there to pick the next fix.
  • Document changes and follow change management from sandbox to production.
  • Current Sales/Marketing Tech Stack: Salesforce, Dealhub CPQ, Hubspot, ZoomInfo, Gong Professional, Gong Engage, Gong Forecasting, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Dripify, Ringlead

Qualifications

  • 3+ years hands-on with Salesforce Sales Cloud (advanced Flow, data and security model), plus HubSpot and/or DealHub CPQ.
  • Working knowledge of Apex, SOQL and REST APIs, and able to write scripts in Python or JavaScript.
  • A track record of replacing manual processes with automation or self-service, with before-and-after examples.
  • Systems thinking: good judgment about where logic and data should live across connected systems.
  • Understanding of lead-to-quote-to-close and the marketing funnel (lead lifecycle, attribution).
  • Comfortable using AI coding and automation tools every day.
  • Clear communicator who can push back on requests with reasons, and works well with business users and engineers.
  • Fluent English, additional languages are a plus.
  • Ability to work in the country of residence (we do not provide visa sponsorship).

Nice to have:

  • Salesforce Platform App Builder or Platform Developer I certification;
  • Git/SFDX; depth in Gong, ZoomInfo or HubSpot; cloud platform experience;
  • experience with an integration platform or event-driven systems.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Accountant (Australian Accounting), IndiaRemote (India) | Full-Time Also searched as: Accounts Executive, Accounts Payable Specialist, Xero Accountant, Bookkeeper What would it take for a financial controller to hand you a company's payables and reconciliations and never need to check behind you?
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Accountant (Australian Accounting), IndiaRemote (India) | Full-Time

Also searched as: Accounts Executive, Accounts Payable Specialist, Xero Accountant, Bookkeeper

What would it take for a financial controller to hand you a company's payables and reconciliations and never need to check behind you?

On a typical day you might clear the team's reimbursement queue and prepare a supplier payment run in Xero in the morning, work a Stripe settlement mismatch down to its source after lunch, and send the Financial Controller a balance sheet workpaper with a flagged query and your recommended fix before the end of day.

About Contour

We started in 2020 with a handful of students and a belief that great education should not be out of reach. Today we operate across three brands with 8,000+ students and 425+ team members: roughly 100 in India and 325 onshore in Australia. The India team runs publishing, student experience, CRM and technology, operations, and people and culture, and this role sits with the group finance function.

Every company at this scale runs on someone who keeps the money side exact. This is that seat.

About This Role

You are the accountant who runs Contour's transactional finance day to day: accounts payable, team member expense reimbursements, and account reconciliations, with balance sheet management as the part that stretches you. The balance sheet work is also why this role needs a qualified accountant rather than a bookkeeper. You report to the Financial Controller, who owns statutory reporting, tax, and sign-off on the monthly close. Everything underneath is yours: what gets paid, what gets reimbursed, and whether every account reconciles.

Two habits separate a strong hire here from a competent one. First, judgement about when to ask and when to act: you raise a blocker early instead of sitting on it, you do not guess on anything material, and once you have the answer you execute without follow-up. Second, you treat an unreconciled difference as a problem to run to ground, not a number to plug.

You start solo in group finance. The work grows with your tenure: management accounting first, then analytical and reporting work, and over time designing the processes rather than running them.

The role matters now because the volume is real: supplier invoices, team member expense claims, and student payments settling through Stripe every day, all of which has to be accurate and on time. By the end of month three, you will have accounts payable and reimbursements running on a predictable cycle with no backlog, bank and Stripe reconciliations current, balance sheet accounts reconciled monthly with workpapers ready for review, and the recurring work documented well enough that someone else could run it from your notes. What you build in those first months becomes how Contour runs this function as it scales.

Where the work lives

  • Xero:the ledger lives here, so clean coding, up-to-date bank feeds, and tidy reconciliations are the baseline.

  • Stripe:student payments settle here, so settlements and fees get reconciled back to Xero, line by line.

  • HubSpot and monday.com:the rest of the business runs here, so billing queries and task status move through them, and updating your status there is how a remote team stays coordinated.

What You Will Do

  • Run accounts payable end to end.Verify supplier invoices, code them correctly in Xero, prepare payment runs, and keep suppliers paid on time.

  • Process team member expense reimbursements.Check claims against policy, query anything that does not look right, and keep turnaround predictable so people are not left waiting on their own money.

  • Own account reconciliations.Bank accounts, Stripe settlements, and key ledger accounts, kept current every month.

  • Manage balance sheet accounts.Maintain the reconciliations and workpapers that support the monthly close, and flag anything material to the Financial Controller before close week.

  • Be the day-to-day contact for auditors.Pull samples, walk them through the workpapers, and keep internal controls tight enough to hold up under inspection.

  • Document what you run.Turn the recurring work into written steps so the function stays reliable as it grows.

If a better way exists to do something we are doing manually, make the case and we will back it.


Requirements

What You Need

  • A commerce degree plus CA Inter, CMA Inter, or part-qualified ACCA (discontinued is fine), or an M.Com, and 2 to 4 years of hands-on accounting work

  • Reconciliation experience across bank, supplier, or settlement accounts

  • Working proficiency in Xero: coding transactions, running bank feeds and reconciliations, and pulling reports without help

  • Balance sheet exposure: you have maintained balance sheet reconciliations or prepared workpapers for a month-end close

  • Sharp written English and comfort working across the India and Australia time difference. Much of your work with the Financial Controller is asynchronous, so a written query or a workpaper note has to land as intended the first time

Nice to Have

  • Australian accounting exposure: GST, BAS, or work for Australian clients

  • Experience supporting a statutory audit

  • Reconciliation work with Stripe or another payment platform

  • Experience in a startup or multi-brand environment

The Kind of People Who Thrive Here
The people who do well here see a gap and close it without being asked, holding the bar even when the clock is short. They give a direct read on the work in front of them, including when it's wrong, and when their own idea doesn't hold up, they say so and bring a better one. They build something that keeps running after they step back. Problems here don't show up on schedule or in the same shape twice, and they'd rather make the right call on limited information than let something break while they wait for a sign-off. That's the job. They name the blocker and the ask the moment they have it, on a call or a text, because decisions get made on the information you bring.

Contour's current cluster heads started as team leads. The path from operator to leader is real here.

What good looks like

  • Nothing needs chasing:suppliers and team members get paid without following up.
  • The close is boring:month-end arrives with nothing left to find.
  • Trusted at a distance:the Financial Controller knows where things stand without having to ask.

Benefits

Fully remote, anywhere in India. Compensation is competitive and benchmarked to the role and your experience, and we discuss it openly early in the process. From application to offer: a short screen, a technical assessment, a culture conversation with our People team, and a final interview with the Financial Controller, in about four weeks.

Apply with a CV and one short paragraph on a discrepancy you caught during a reconciliation: how you spotted it and what you did next.

You will join a small, automation-forward RevOps team at an inflection point, where the systems you design now become how we sell for years.

vCluster Labs is the company behind vCluster, which provisions fully isolated tenant clusters on Kubernetes, bare metal, and VMs for AI Clouds, enterprises, and platform teams.

As a Revenue Operations Specialist, your role will include:

  • Deal desk and quote-to-cash: You will be the first responder when a quote or order form looks wrong. You will own quote line items, term-length logic, and order forms in Salesforce, Ironclad contract workflows, and the Stripe to Salesforce ARR sync.

  • Salesforce administration and automation: You will build, update, and fix flows, formulas, and automations. If it can be automated, we automate it, and you will help decide how.

  • Rep support and enablement: You will own the Salesforce request queue during US hours and help AEs, especially new hires, set up deals correctly. The best version of this role teaches reps how our Salesforce works so the same question does not come back twice.

  • Commissions: You will support QuotaPath and how reps get paid, partnering with our COO on deal reviews and resolving pay discrepancies.

  • Reporting and dashboards: You will keep pipeline, renewal, ARR, and territory dashboards accurate, answer “why does this number look off,” and build new views as sales leadership asks for them.

  • Data hygiene and documentation: You will own recurring data fixes and keep our RevOps process docs current, so how we quote, approve, and report is written down and repeatable.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Hands-on Salesforce experience: 3+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, or deal desk, including building and maintaining Salesforce flows and automations. Certification is not required; real build experience is.

  • Quote-to-cash fluency: You understand how revenue flows through a CRM, from quote line items to order forms to booked ARR.

  • Reporting instincts: You build Salesforce reports and dashboards, reconcile numbers across systems, and can explain a discrepancy clearly to a sales leader.

  • B2B SaaS background: You know how SaaS deals are structured and how revenue is recognized.

  • Service mindset at speed: You enjoy owning a queue, turn requests around in hours rather than days, and stay patient when the same question comes in again.

  • Resourcefulness: When you have not built something before, you figure it out, including using AI tools like Claude to get there faster.

Bonus points for:

  • Ironclad: Experience with Ironclad or another contract lifecycle tool.

  • Commissions tooling: Hands-on time in QuotaPath or a similar tool.

  • Salesforce Administrator certification or CPQ experience: A plus, not a requirement.

  • Tableau or a ground-up build: Tableau experience, or you have built RevOps from scratch at an early-stage company.

Why you will love this role:

  • Build it your way: You will have real input into how our processes and automations are designed, not just inherit someone else’s.

  • See the whole company: You will work hands-on across the full GTM tech stack and support sales, marketing, partners, finance, and leadership.

  • Grow with us: Join early at an inflection point, with room to shape your path, including building and leading a team as we scale.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. 💰 Competitive, dependent on experience

The Opportunity

You will be work on of one of Kyra's largest and most complex global enterprise accounts: a fast-moving, multi-category consumer brand with 12+ sub-brands, 35+ active stakeholders, and campaigns running simultaneously across multiple regions.

Your job is to keep delivery tight, keep the client happy, and be a safe pair of hands on a flagship account. This is not about growing or expanding the account. The commercial relationship is locked in. The job is world-class servicing at enterprise scale.

What you'll do:

  • Work on the global account relationship across 12+ sub-brands and multiple regions. Stay organised across a volume of comms, briefs, and stakeholders that is genuinely unusual.

  • Orchestrate cross-functional teams: creative, paid media, creator partnerships, and product. You are the connective tissue. If something drifts, you see it early and fix it.

  • If something drifts (performance, scope, relationship, or timeline) you see it early and fix it. No surprises. Steady, organised ownership.

🎯 Co-own the Relationship Work on client relationships across product launches, seasonal campaigns, and always-on programmes. Multi-thread across their teams. Build trust at every level. Have direct conversations when performance needs to improve.

📈 Turn Insight into Strategy Translate campaign data into clear, executive-level recommendations using AI to move from raw numbers to narrative faster. Present performance against KPIs (engagement, EMV, sales lift, affiliate impact) and explain what it means.

With 6+ briefs running simultaneously, operational precision is everything. Keep work on-brand, on-time, and within margin.

Proactive. Organised. Adaptable. Self-starting. Comfortable with ambiguity.

If you speak one of these languages - Spanish, French, German, Italian

jobs.excerpt: About DoitWe are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more.
jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

  • Can you can wear a lot of hats? We're a small company and not much for bureaucratic divisions. The boss codes; the project manager gives sales demos; most everyone, including you, does a shift of at least a few hours each week answering our clients' support tickets.

Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We’re looking for a Broker Relationship Executive

As the face of iwoca to a wide range of UK brokers, you will act as a trusted advisor, problem solver, and relationship builder. From training brokers on our products to advocating for their deals internally and attending key industry events, you will be given the autonomy and support to take ownership of a high-impact portfolio and directly drive our market expansion.

The role

You will manage day-to-day interactions across our expanding UK network, with a strong focus on long-tail broker accounts. You will combine phone, email, LinkedIn, and face-to-face outreach to unlock partner potential, while leveraging internal data tools to track pipeline performance and maintain accurate CRM records.

Responsibilities

  • Proactively build iwoca’s presence across the UK by acquiring, engaging, and activating broker relationships across all communication channels.

  • Champion broker needs internally by collaborating with credit assessment, operations, and product teams to progress applications and resolve queries.

  • Deliver a seamless on-boarding experience for new brokers, guiding them step-by-step through their initial deal submissions.

  • Serve as the dedicated first point of contact for long-tail broker accounts outside of standard panels to support their ongoing daily requests.

  • Monitor activity metrics and pipeline data to spot engagement trends, identify high-potential partners, and step in to support at-risk relationships.

  • Conduct training sessions to keep partners up to date on iwoca policies, and represent the business at regional and industry networking events.

Requirements

We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve. To succeed as a Broker Relationship Executive, you’ll also bring:

  • A minimum of 2 years client management experience

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a professional phone manner, and confidence delivering presentations both in person and virtually via webinars.

  • Commercial curiosity with a genuine interest in financial products, third-party dynamics, and how brokers operate within the lending ecosystem.

  • Strong organisational skills and a self-directed approach, with a proven track record of managing a high-volume workload, prioritising your calendar, and taking ownership of new responsibilities to a high standard.

  • A confident, people-focused mindset, taking pride in personal contributions while thriving as a collaborative team player dedicated to building strong relationships.

  • Proficiency using CRM tools and dashboards to track broker engagement, monitor pipeline data, and manage a dispersed portfolio of accounts.

  • Willingness to travel via car or train for partner meetings and industry events, including occasional overnight stays.

The salary

We expect to pay from £35,000 - £50,000 + bonus for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

jobs.description:
Description

Global Vice President, Marketing

Location: US / Canada (Eastern Time) - Home based

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

About AllCloud

AllCloud is a leader in amplifying organizations’ cloud potential through AI. With a track record of hundreds of successful migrations and implementations across AWS and Salesforce, AllCloud has developed strategies and solutions that enable businesses of all sizes to remain at the forefront of innovation.

AllCloud is a leader in AI-led professional and managed services. As an AWS Premier and audited managed services Partner, and Salesforce Consulting partner, AllCloud provides comprehensive AI-led cloud journey support, from initial migration to ongoing management through our Engage Managed Services. Our expertise ensures that clients remain aligned with ecosystem best practices while focusing on their core business growth.

AllCloud serves clients across the globe with offices in EMEA and North America. www.allcloud.io

Job Summary

AllCloud is seeking a Vice President of Global Marketing to drive consistent, high-performing demand generation and go-to-market execution across all regions in which we go-to-market. This is a hands-on, execution-first leadership role for someone who thrives operating at every altitude, equally comfortable presenting to the executive team in the morning and rolling up their sleeves at a client or partner event that evening.

The ideal candidate has deep experience in professional services marketing, ideally within the cloud, systems integrator, or IT consulting space, and understands how to translate a global marketing strategy into regional execution. They know how to get things done through and alongside a distributed team of regional marketing directors, and are comfortable operating in a channel-driven business where marketing plans are closely tied to partners like AWS, Salesforce, and Anthropic. This role is less about setting new strategic direction and more about driving disciplined, consistent execution of the marketing plan worldwide.

Requirements

Summary of Requirements & Experience:

Global Execution Leadership

  • Working with the CMO, this role will own end-to-end execution of AllCloud's global marketing plan across all regions, ensuring consistency in quality, messaging, and cadence
  • Translate global priorities into clear, actionable regional plans in partnership with each Regional Marketing Director
  • Track execution against plan and budget, identify gaps or bottlenecks early, and step in directly to keep programs on track

Demand Generation & Go-to-Market

  • Lead demand generation strategy and execution across multiple regions, including campaigns, pipeline programs, and lead-to-revenue processes for AllCloud's professional and managed services offerings
  • Drive go-to-market execution including strategy development, creative, and messaging across regions
  • Partner with regional sales leadership to ensure marketing programs are generating and supporting pipeline effectively
  • Ensure AllCloud brand standards are upheld while still pushing creativity and innovation in campaigns

Alliance & Partner Marketing Execution

  • Work closely with the CMO & VPs of Alliances to execute co-marketing programs with AWS, Salesforce, Anthropic, and other key technology partners
  • Ensure regional teams are effectively leveraging partner funding, MDF, and joint marketing programs as part of the global plan
  • Work with alliances leaders to develop a plan and support partner-related events, launches, and campaigns from planning through execution

Regional Team Leadership

  • Manage and mentor Regional Marketing Directors, providing hands-on support, coaching, and accountability
  • Roll up sleeves alongside regional teams when needed, reviewing campaign details, jumping into event logistics, or helping troubleshoot execution issues in real time
  • Establish shared standards, playbooks, and tools that regional teams can execute against consistently

Executive & Cross-Functional Engagement

  • Represent global marketing execution status and results to the CMO and executive leadership
  • Partner with sales, alliances, and client service leadership to ensure marketing execution supports firm-wide business goals
  • Communicate clearly and credibly with senior stakeholders while remaining grounded in the operational details

What Success Looks Like

  • Demand generation programs deliver measurable, reliable pipeline contribution and high ROI across all regions
  • Regional marketing teams execute the global plan consistently and on time, with minimal friction
  • Partner co-marketing programs with strategic partners AWS, Salesforce and Anthropic ensure they are fully leveraged and well-executed at the regional level
  • Marketing has a visible, trusted presence at client and partner events across regions
  • Executive leadership has confidence in marketing's execution discipline and reporting
  • Regional Marketing Directors are well-supported, coached, and held accountable to shared standards

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of marketing experience, including 5+ years in a leadership role managing marketing teams across multiple regions or countries
  • Direct experience in professional services marketing; experience in a cloud, systems integrator, or IT consulting environment strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with technology alliance/partner marketing programs (e.g., AWS, Salesforce, Snowflake, or similar ISV/hyperscaler ecosystems) is a strong plus
  • Proven track record leading demand generation programs and go-to-market execution at scale
  • Experience managing and developing a team of regional marketing leaders
  • Demonstrated ability to move fluidly between executive-level strategy conversations and hands-on, in-the-weeds execution
  • Willingness and ability to travel regionally and internationally, including hands-on support at client and partner events
  • Strong project management and operational discipline; comfortable holding self and others accountable to deadlines and standards
  • Excellent communication skills, with the credibility to engage confidently with C-suite executives and the flexibility to work directly with field teams

About you:

This role is best suited for someone who describes themselves as a "doer" more than a "strategist,” someone energized by execution and detail. They should be comfortable with ambiguity, capable of stepping into any regional market to help solve a problem, and driven by seeing programs through to completion rather than handing off execution to others. Experience operating in a partner-driven professional services business, where alliances, co-marketing, and sales collaboration are core to how marketing wins, will make this candidate especially effective at AllCloud.

Why work for us?

Our team inspires progress in each other and in our customers through our relentless pursuit of excellence; you will work with leaders who promote learning and personal development.

AllCloud is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law.

jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Technical Product Manager to own Oura's IT service management (ITSM) and employee service management (ESM) platforms. You will lead our move off a legacy ITSM tool to a modern, AI-native platform, then bring service management to teams like HR, Finance, Legal, and Security on whichever platform or platforms fit them best. You will be fluent in ITSM theory, comfortable evaluating tools without bias, and willing to roll up your sleeves to configure, integrate, and ship. Above all, you will care about the people on the other side of every request and work to make getting help easy and seamless.

What You Will Do:

  • Lead the migration from our legacy ITSM platform to a modern, AI-native one, from data model, workflow, and catalog design through integrations, cutover, and decommission, with no loss in service levels or employee satisfaction
  • Be the voice of the employee. Design requests, catalog items, and knowledge from the worker's point of view so getting help is easy and frictionless, and use feedback and service data to keep removing friction
  • Own the platform as a product: a single roadmap and backlog, clear intake, and prioritization criteria that every service team can see and trust
  • Govern the service catalog and request fulfillment. Decide what gets added, changed, or retired, and move requests from manual work toward automated and identity-governed fulfillment
  • Own the knowledge management function: the standards, structure, and governance that make knowledge accurate and findable for people and AI agents alike, while individual teams keep ownership of their own content
  • Define how AI agents operate in service management: which requests they resolve, which they route to a human, and the accuracy thresholds and guardrails behind each
  • Build a repeatable onboarding model for ESM so non-IT service teams can adopt a consistent service experience, whichever platform fits them (intake, catalog, workflows, knowledge, reporting, access controls)
  • Keep the platform audit-ready by designing change, incident, and access workflows that produce the evidence our SOX, SOC 2, and HIPAA controls require
  • Work hands-on in the platform and with engineers on configuration, integrations, and automation, and direct vendor and partner work where needed

This is a remote role based in the US.

What you'll bring

  • 6+ years in IT service management, service platform, or internal-tools product roles
  • Led at least one end-to-end ITSM or ESM tool implementation or migration through go-live
  • Strong grounding in ITSM concepts and practices (ITIL or equivalent), and the judgment to evaluate platforms on their merits rather than loyalty to one vendor
  • Hands-on depth with a modern service management platform, including service catalog, workflow and SLA configuration, knowledge management, and reporting
  • Experience with an AI-native ITSM platform (such as Atomicwork or Serval), or with Jira Service Management, Freshservice, or similar
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow, including its data model, workflows, and administration, and how to get data and configuration back out of it
  • Experience designing access-request and fulfillment workflows integrated with an identity provider or identity governance platform
  • Experience applying AI in a service desk: knowledge grounding, intent classification and routing, automated resolution, accuracy evaluation, guardrails, and human handoff
  • Technical depth to make and defend design calls with engineers: REST APIs, webhooks, SSO and SCIM, JSON data models, LLM and agent integrations (such as MCP and tool calling), and scripting in Python or JavaScript
  • A track record of running a platform as a product for multiple internal customer teams, including prioritizing across competing demand
  • Genuine empathy for the people you serve, with a record of simplifying service experiences and removing friction for employees
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including translating platform trade-offs for service owners outside IT
  • Daily use of AI assistants, agents, and AI-assisted build tools (such as Claude, Claude Code, or Cursor) to ship scripts, reports, and prototypes, with good judgment about when to verify output and when AI is the wrong tool

Nice to have:

  • Experience with identity governance, including birthright and role-based access models
  • CMDB or asset-management data modeling, including device lifecycle integrations
  • Knowledge management program experience, including controlled vocabularies, taxonomy, and metadata standards; content governance and ongoing stewardship; and grounding AI agents in governed knowledge with source citation (retrieval-augmented generation, or RAG, design beyond vendor defaults)
  • ESM experience with non-IT teams such as HR, Facilities, or Legal, including handling sensitive employee data
  • SOX ITGC experience in a pre-IPO or public company
  • Familiarity with iPaaS tools such as Workato
  • Experience supporting distributed teams across US and EMEA time zones
  • ITIL 4 certification

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
