About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the Role

Reports to the Operations Principal, Change. The Strategic Operations team sits between Product, Technology, and Claims Operations and owns the work that turns a shipped feature into a change the organization actually runs on.

We build most of our own technology, and the pace at which it reaches adjusters, managers, and customer-facing teams is picking up as the company scales. Each release changes how work is completed at Reserv, and each one needs someone who owns the stretch between "engineering says it's ready" and "the people who do the work have changed how they do it, and we can see it in the data." That is this role.

You own the product side of the function: the launch runway, readiness against the standard, pilot design, training and communications, and adoption reporting for every release. You will run day-to-day execution on launches yourself and work alongside the Operations Lead who owns process change. You will be an excellent fit if you have run cross-functional rollouts before, hold dates when it's uncomfortable to, and can write for an adjuster in the morning and a manager in the afternoon.

Duties & Responsibilities

Launch Readiness: Run every product launch against the readiness standard: pilot-or-not decided, end-to-end process documented, change plan approved, training and communications planned, materials built, onboarding updated, adoption metrics live, and SOPs current. Assemble the evidence for sign-off, flag gaps early, and recommend how much of the standard a given release needs.

Launch Program Management: Own the roadmap of product launches end to end, from the first estimate of when a release lands through go-live and stabilization. Hold dates, sequence launches that affect the same teams, design pilots with a ringfenced group before company-wide rollout, and escalate to the Principal and Product with specifics when a release isn't ready.

Training, Enablement, and Communications: Build and execute the training and multi-channel communications plan for each launch for leaders, managers, and frontline teams: announcements, FAQs, video walkthroughs, live sessions, office hours, and tracked completion. Coordinate with Product on how-to materials and with Learning & Development so new-hire onboarding reflects the current state.

Adoption Measurement and Feedback: Define adoption and failure metrics for each release before go-live and build the reporting with the Data team so it is live at launch. Feed usage into the regular report that reaches team leads, managers, and directors. Run the feedback channels for launches: adjuster and team-lead panels, structured pilot debriefs, and the issue-reporting workflow, and carry what the field learns back to Product with specifics.

Metric and Data Management: This person will be responsible for continually tracking metrics to determine success and make data-driven changes to rollouts

Requirements

  • 1-3+ years in management consulting, operational transformation, operations management, or a similar role where you redesigned how a team works and documented it.
  • Proven ability to manage a launch calendar: multiple concurrent rollouts against dates, with pilots, debriefs, and escalations.
  • An effective writer and presenter, from adjuster-facing guides and FAQs to manager-level communications and live training.
  • Fluency with business intelligence tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI) to define adoption metrics, build reporting with a data team, and read what the numbers say.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with real comfort holding several launches in flight at different stages.
  • Active use of AI tools in your own work, and interest in applying them to how launches run.
  • Claims or insurance experience is helpful but not required.
  • Bachelor's degree (lack of one should not stop you from applying if you possess all the other qualifications).

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Enterprise Business Development Manager
jobs.excerpt: About the opportunityWe’re looking for a driven, commercially sharp Enterprise Business Development Manager to open head office doors with the UK’s multi-site restaurant groups and bring them onto First Table at scale.
jobs.description:
About the opportunity

We’re looking for a driven, commercially sharp Enterprise Business Development Manager to open head office doors with the UK’s multi-site restaurant groups and bring them onto First Table at scale.

This is a newly created, national new-business role. Until now we have signed restaurants one site at a time through our regional BDMs. You’ll change that for groups: selling at head office level under group master agreements covering current and future sites, rather than site by site.

The UK & Ireland is one of our biggest growth bets, with a plan to multiply supply across 22 target cities over the next two years. You’ll have a defined named-account list built from our proprietary market data, the backing of our field sales and Partner Success teams, and the freedom to build a group portfolio from zero.

This is a full-time, permanent role reporting to our GM, UK & Ireland.

About us

At First Table, our vision is simple: to be the first place diners go to book a table.

First Table now offers our great dining experiences at amazing restaurants across the UK. Following the recent city launches in Bournemouth, Leicester, Norwich, and Southampton, we are doubling down on building a strong presence and connected team across the UK.

First Table is a dining discovery platform that connects diners to restaurants through their love of food. Through our clever tech, we help restaurants get their night off to a great start and give diners a compelling reason to try somewhere new. It’s a win-win situation. From early bird offers to last table reservations, we make discovering and booking great dining experiences fast, easy, and rewarding.

At the heart of everything we do are our values: Grow Together, Win-Win-Win, and Own It. These guide how we show up for each other, our restaurant partners, and our diners and they’re a big part of what makes First Table a great place to work.

Learn more about our story here:

About the role

You’ll own new-business sales to the UK’s multi-site restaurant groups. Your named-account list is made up of bookable, premium-casual groups where our model demonstrably works, including brands already live on First Table whose sites outperform the typical independent. Your job is to turn that list into master agreements, and master agreements into live sites, on rollout schedules you negotiate and drive.

This is a hunting role. Once a group’s sites are live, they move to our Partner Success team for account management and you move on to the next deal, re-engaging an existing group only to extend the agreement or sell new sites into it.

If you’re looking for a book to manage, this isn’t that job. If you want to open head office doors and build a group portfolio from zero, it is.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the named-account list: prospect, qualify and prioritise the UK’s dining groups, starting with brands already live on the platform whose numbers make the case for us.
  • Sell at head office level, reaching operations directors, commercial directors and founders, and running multi-stakeholder sales cycles of 3 to 6 months.
  • Close group master agreements covering current and future sites.
  • Negotiate rollout schedules into every agreement and drive them, working with Partner Success on onboarding and local BDMs on launch support, so contracted sites actually go live.
  • Build the group proposition: group-level performance reporting, a single point of contact during rollout, and expansion cases built on live site data.
  • Run a clean pipeline in HubSpot on group parent records, with honest stage data, so forecasts are trusted.
  • Prioritise brands on our live reservation-system integrations, highlight stalled pipeline by reservation partner, and feed head office insights back into our product and partnerships plans.
  • Build relationships with key third parties to open doors with target groups, and represent First Table at industry and networking events

What you’ll bring

  • A proven track record in new-business sales with head office or multi-site deals behind you, whether in hospitality groups, retail chains, FMCG into multiples, or B2B platforms sold to estates.
  • Experience opening doors cold and closing multi-stakeholder deals with long sales cycles.
  • A commercial mindset: you build the business case in the client’s numbers (covers, revenue per site, off-peak utilisation), not in adjectives.
  • The drive to finish: you know a signed agreement earns nothing until sites go live, and you manage rollouts with the same energy as the pitch.
  • An understanding of how restaurant groups run, or the ability to learn fast. Familiarity with reservation systems is a plus.
  • A self-starter who thrives with national scope as a team of one, setting your own plan, running your own diary, and asking for help early when a deal needs it.

Why you’ll love working with us

  • Flexible working hours and the autonomy to manage your own schedule
  • Remote-first, but never remote-feeling
  • Competitive OTE (base salary + commissions), plus paid travel
  • A newly created role with an opportunity to make your mark
  • The backing of our field sales and Partner Success teams, so your deals turn into live sites
  • Free First Table bookings as a team perk - perfect for fellow food lovers.
  • We recognise great work, with team-wide recognition shoutouts, referral incentives, and regular opportunities to celebrate wins.
  • Being part of a purpose-led, award-winning brand that champions exceptional dining experiences and values creativity, collaboration and growth.

What’s next?

Ready to bring the UK’s best restaurant groups onto First Table? We’d love to hear from you.

Please submit your application, including your CV and a brief cover letter, via the Apply Now link. In your cover letter, let us know what excites you about this opportunity and how your experience sets you up for success.

Applications close Friday 23 October 2026.

Things to keep in mind:

  • Applicants must already be based in the UK to be considered for this role
  • Applicants for this position must have pre-existing rights to work in United Kingdom

The ideal candidate brings strong organizational skills, an analytical mindset, and an interest in the financial operations of clinical research. Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and issue accurate, timely invoices for clinical trial activities, including study start-up, participant visits, milestones, recurring fees, and reimbursable expenses.

  • Familiarity with clinical trial billing, sponsor/CRO payments, or study-level financial tracking is highly desirable.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external partners.

About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the Role

The Strategic Operations team sits between Product, Technology, and Claims Operations. This role owns the function that turns a shipped feature, or a redesigned process, into a change the organization actually runs on.

We build most of our own technology, and the pace at which it reaches adjusters, managers, and customer-facing teams is picking up as the company scales. Each release and each process change alters how work is completed at Reserv. We are hiring an Operations Principal to own the function that makes those changes land: the standard every change meets before go-live, the sequencing of changes across teams, the readiness work, and the measurement that shows adoption happened.

You will lead two Operations Leads. One owns product launches and adoption: readiness, pilots, training, and whether the technology we ship gets used. The other owns process design and change: how work is designed, documented, and changed across claims operations, with or without a product release behind it. They run the work. You set the standard they run it to, decide how much of it a given change needs, arbitrate when their runways collide on the same teams, and hold the relationships with Product, Data, Learning & Development, and claims leadership. You will build the function into one that runs systematically. You will be an excellent fit if you have built or led a small team, have run cross-functional change at scale, hold dates when it's uncomfortable to, and can write for an executive audience without losing the detail.

Duties & Responsibilities

Change Management Framework and Governance: Own the standard every product launch and process change must meet before go-live, and the governance around it: who signs off, what evidence is required, and how much of the standard a given change needs. Keep the framework, its documentation, and the change history current, and decide when the framework itself has to change. Apply AI tools to how the function runs, from drafting change plans to tracking adoption.

Function Design and Operating Cadence: Build the function so it operates systematically: the intake path by which new launches and changes reach the team, the operating cadence between your Leads and their counterparts in Product, Data, and L&D, and the templates and playbooks each change runs on. Deposita(TM), An Allied Universal(R) Company has perfected the art of cash management using world-class innovation, technology, and tailored solutions. Deposita, an Allied Universal® Company, is hiring a Senior Director, Implementation.The Senior Director, Implementation is a commercial operations leader with full ownership of the planning, scheduling, budgeting, and successful delivery of cash recycler implementations for new and existing customers. This position carries direct financial accountability for the implementation portfolio, including project budgets, cost control, and margin performance, and is expected to read, interpret, and act on P&L results as part of daily decision-making.

The Senior Director leads a team of Project Managers ranging from early career to highly experienced and is responsible for developing each of them: building structure, training, and oversight for newer PMs while setting stretch objectives and delegating autonomy to seasoned PMs. This is a fast-paced, high-volume environment with shifting priorities and firm customer deadlines; the leader in this role must solve problems quickly, build repeatable processes where none exist, and hold the team accountable to schedule and budget.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Commercial and Financial Ownership

  • Own the financial performance of the implementation portfolio: develop project budgets, control costs, monitor margin, and deliver projects within approved budget
  • Read, interpret, and act on P&L statements; identify variances, determine root causes, and drive corrective action; present financial results and forecasts to senior leadership
  • Establish and maintain financial oversight of inventory and services to ensure effective alignment with client goals and objectives

Team Leadership and Development

  • Directly supervise multiple Project Managers with varying levels of experience; adapt coaching, delegation, and oversight to each individual's capability
  • Build onboarding, training, and development plans for early-career Project Managers; set stretch objectives and expanded ownership for experienced Project Managers
  • Communicate project expectations clearly and in a timely fashion; hold team members and contractors accountable for their assigned work; assess staffing needs during the project cycle and recruit as necessary

Implementation Planning and Delivery

  • Plan and schedule cash recycler installation timelines; define project scope, goals, deadlines, milestones, and deliverables for each implementation
  • Identify and manage project dependencies and critical path; proactively manage changes in scope, identify potential crises, and devise contingency plans
  • Coordinate manufacturing partners, training partners, third-party contractors, customers, and Deposita Retail teams to deliver installations that meet customer requirements and are supportable by the Customer Support Centers
  • Conduct customer operating reviews depicting implementation progress, support performance, and metrics; determine the frequency and content of status reporting, analyze results, and troubleshoot problem areas

Success is measured by on-time, on-budget delivery, achievement of Service Level Agreements (SLAs), financial performance of the implementation portfolio, process adoption, and the development and retention of the project management team

  • Develop, document, and scale repeatable implementation processes, playbooks, and tools; drive adoption across the team

  • Bring deep hands-on Smartsheet expertise to own the design and administration of the team's Smartsheet project plans, dashboards, reports, and automations

    • Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, marketing, or a computer technology related field
    • Associate's degree in business administration, finance, marketing, or a computer technology related field with at least nine (9) years of experience in business operations, program/project delivery, or implementation leadership, and four (4) years of related financial and/or process leadership experience
    • High School Diploma or equivalent with at least twelve (12) years of experience in business operations, program/project delivery, or implementation leadership, and five (5) years of related financial and/or process leadership experience
  • Minimum of seven (7) years of experience in business operations, program/project delivery, or implementation leadership within a fast-paced service, technology, or field-installation environment
  • Minimum of three (3) years of direct financial or P&L responsibility, including budgeting, forecasting, and cost/margin management
  • Minimum of three (3) years of direct people leadership, including hiring, developing, and managing project management or delivery professionals

    • Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment
    • Ability to adapt to shifting priorities, demands, and timelines through analytical and problem-solving capabilities
    • Ability to learn, understand, and apply new technologies

This is a remote position.

Mathematics Subject Matter Expert, India Remote, India,Freelance, project-based.
Also searched as: Maths Subject Matter Expert, Maths Expert, Q&A Expert, Academic Content Expert, Freelance Maths Content Writer, VCE Maths Content Developer
Do you want to create high-quality maths resources on your own schedule, paid per project, for a company that actually cares how good they are?
A typical brief might be a set of exam-style questions for a Year 11 topic with full worked solutions, or a booklet section aligned to the VCE syllabus, delivered to a clear spec and an agreed deadline.
About Contour
We started in 2020 with a handful of students and a belief that great education should not be out of reach. Today we operate across three brands with 8,000+ students and 425+ team members: roughly 100 in India and 325 onshore in Australia. The India team runs publishing, student experience, CRM and technology, operations, and people and culture.
Freelance does not mean lower standards here. Your worked solution is still the moment a stuck student gets it or does not, so clarity is still the whole job.
About This Role
You create original mathematics content for Contour on a project basis. You take clear briefs from the content team and produce questions, worked solutions, booklet sections, and assessments for Grades 9 to 12, aligned to the VCE and Pre-VCE syllabus. The quality bar is the same as our in-house team: accurate, logically structured, with step-by-step solutions written in a tutor's voice that a student can follow on their own. To be clear, this is content creation, you build resources from a brief, rather than answering one-off student questions.
You work remotely on your own schedule, to deadlines agreed per project. This is freelance and project-based, paid per project or per resource, agreed openly upfront. It suits experienced content creators, tutors, and strong postgraduates who want flexible work without dropping their standards. Reliable delivery and consistent quality can turn into ongoing work or, if you want it, a full-time seat.
What You Will Do
  • Take briefs and build. Produce original maths content to a clear spec: questions, worked solutions, booklet sections, and assessments.
  • Write like a tutor. Deliver step-by-step, student-friendly solutions that explain the reasoning, not just the answer.
  • Align to the syllabus. Match the VCE and Pre-VCE curricula for accuracy, consistency, and fit.
  • Deliver to deadline. Manage your own schedule and hand work in on time, to spec.
  • Revise cleanly. Take feedback and turn it around without losing quality.

Requirements

What You Need

  • Strong mathematics, comfortable across Grades 9 to 12, VCE ideally.
  • A proven ability to write clear content and worked solutions, with a sample or portfolio to show it.
  • Excellent written English and sharp attention to detail.
  • Reliability to deadlines, and the self-management that freelance work needs.
  • Cross-timezone comfort, with some overlap into Australian time for briefs and feedback.
Nice to Have
  • Familiarity with VCE mathematics or another international curriculum.
  • Prior edtech content, academic writing, or tutoring experience.
  • A portfolio of maths resources or worked solutions you have created.
The Kind of People Who Thrive Here

The people who do well here see a gap and close it without being asked, holding the bar even when the clock is short. They give a direct read on the work in front of them, including when it's wrong, and when their own idea doesn't hold up, they say so and bring a better one. They build something that keeps running after they step back. Problems here don't show up on schedule or in the same shape twice, and they'd rather make the right call on limited information than let something break while they wait for a sign-off. That's the job. They name the blocker and the ask the moment they have it, on a call or a text, because decisions get made on the information you bring.

Contour's current cluster heads started as team leads. The path from operator to leader is real here.

What good looks like
  • Briefs delivered on time, to standard, with minimal revisions needed.
  • Solutions a student can follow alone: the reasoning is visible, not just the result.
  • Syllabus-aligned: material fits the VCE and Pre-VCE curricula and holds up.
  • A relationship, not a one-off: the quality earns ongoing work.

Benefits

Freelance and fully remote, anywhere in India. You work your own schedule to deadlines agreed per project. Compensation is per project or per resource, agreed openly upfront. Reliable, high-quality contributors can move into ongoing work or a full-time role if they want it. From application to offer: a short screen, a technical assessment, a culture conversation with our People team, and a final interview with the Content Development Lead, in about four weeks.

Apply with a CV or portfolio and a short sample: a few questions with full worked solutions, or a booklet section you have written. If you have VCE-aligned work, lead with that.

As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Staff Solutions Engineer, MSSP Partner, you will be tasked with supporting the growth of our MSSP partner business across North America, driving adoption, building strong partner relationships, and evangelizing our solutions across the Americas. You will focus on enabling the MSSP ecosystem, positioning and integrating SentinelOne's technology within partner technical offerings, selling to the managed partner base, conducting demos, delivering technical training and Proofs of Value, assisting partners with pre and post sales activities, and assisting with escalations. You will manage our MSSP partners while cultivating long-term relationships with partners, the SentinelOne field, and Product/Engineering teams.

This role requires a willingness to travel up to 50 percent.

What Will You Do?

  • Help prospective and current partners understand the benefits of SentinelOne, explaining technical features and problem-solving potential roadblocks, all while building champions who are equally as passionate about SentinelOne.
  • Embody the four pillars of our Partner SE team: build and enable tech champions across partners, leveraging the ecosystem; support partner GTM strategies and co-create joint solutions and offerings through practice and service development; drive technical sales success across the entire customer and partner journey; and build community by owning your franchise and building a network of trusted cohorts.

  • Develop and execute technical training plans for partners.

  • Be motivated by partner success and growing partner relationships.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

  • 15 or more years in the field, including 8 or more years of Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Professional Services experience.

  • An exceptional track record of growing managed partner technical resources and a strong background in building relationships with internal sales and product teams.
  • Experience presenting and delivering technical demos and sales value presentations to varying audiences, from architects to C-level executives.
  • Previous experience as a practitioner at an MSSP, MSP, MDR, or IR partner, or in a SOC.
  • Strong familiarity with EDR, XDR, SIEM or other data lake solutions, and cloud technologies, along with a strong understanding of cybersecurity, identity security, and endpoint security solutions, including complex cybersecurity threats and attack vectors and solutions such as malware prevention and XDR/SIEM.
  • Experience working with cloud computing environments, such as in a technical sales, DevOps, security, or sales engineering role, including AWS, Azure, and/or GCP (Azure is a plus).

POSITION SUMMARY
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Construction Development Intelligence & Estimating Coordinator to support business development research, project opportunity identification, estimating coordination, and pipeline management for a U.S.-based infrastructure construction business.
The successful candidate will research upcoming construction and land development projects, monitor permitting and approval processes, identify qualified business opportunities, and maintain accurate records of estimating and bidding activities.
The role requires practical familiarity with construction, civil engineering, site development, or land development. The ideal candidate should be comfortable reviewing public development records, communicating with technical professionals, using AI tools to support research, and maintaining accountability for project follow-ups and deadlines.
This position is suitable for someone who combines construction industry knowledge with strong research, analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Construction and Development Research
  • Review permit applications, planning records, zoning information, annexation activity, and development approvals.
  • Assess civil and site plans at a business development screening level.
  • Determine the current stage of development projects, including planning, permitting, preconstruction, bidding, and construction.
  • Identify developers, property owners, civil engineers, consultants, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Evaluate whether identified projects align with the organization's construction services and target markets.
  • Verify project information and escalate technical engineering questions when necessary.
2. Business Development Intelligence
  • Monitor construction and land development activity across designated locations in Delaware, Maryland, and North Carolina.
  • Use public records, development intelligence platforms, and other research tools to identify upcoming projects.
  • Research project scope, estimated size, approval status, timelines, and key contacts.
  • Identify potential opportunities before they reach the formal bidding stage.
  • Prioritize qualified, relevant opportunities rather than simply generating large volumes of leads.
  • Work toward a target of approximately 5–10 qualified, engaged opportunities per month in each designated municipality or county.

3. AI-Assisted Research and Analysis
  • Use AI tools to improve the speed and organization of project research.
  • Summarize public records, development information, and project documentation.
  • Verify AI-generated findings against reliable sources and identify errors, inconsistencies, or missing information.
  • Improve research prompts and workflows to support more accurate and efficient results.
  • Apply independent judgment when evaluating findings and determining whether opportunities meet the organization's requirements.
4. Estimating and Pipeline Coordination
  • Track upcoming opportunities, bid invitations, submission deadlines, assigned estimators, submitted bids, and follow-up actions.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project pipeline records.
  • Follow up with estimators and project managers on outstanding tasks, agreed deadlines, and next steps.
  • Identify stalled opportunities and overdue actions and escalate significant delays to management.
  • Provide concise weekly updates highlighting priority projects, pipeline progress, and outstanding commitments.
5. Database and Records Management
  • Maintain organized project and opportunity databases using Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Lists, or other approved systems.
  • Record project locations, development stages, permit status, estimated size, priorities, assigned team members, and next actions.
  • Ensure records are accurate, complete, consistent, and accessible to relevant team members.
  • Prepare regular reports on research findings, qualified opportunities, and pipeline activity.
6. Stakeholder and Public Agency Communication
  • Research project information through municipal, county, planning, zoning, and permitting systems.
  • Contact relevant public agencies when necessary information is unavailable online.
  • Communicate professionally with civil engineers, developers, consultants, and other project stakeholders.
  • Request clarification on project status and publicly available information.
  • Document information received and maintain appropriate follow-up records.

Requirements

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE
  • A bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Architecture, Urban or Regional Planning, Project Management, Real Estate Development, or a related discipline.

SOCIAL CONTENT

MANAGER.

Remote

THE ROLE

The Social Content Manager owns the day-to-day social programs for assigned client accounts — and shoots them. This is a hands-on role that runs strategy through execution: building the calendar, traveling to destinations to capture original photo and vertical video, editing and publishing, managing the community, and reporting on what worked. It suits someone who can hold a client conversation in the morning and be shooting on location that afternoon, and who knows the difference between content that should ship quickly while a moment is live and content that deserves to be finished properly. The role reports to the Social Content Director and works closely with Creative, Production, Paid Media, and Account teams.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Social practitioner who is equally comfortable building a strategy and operating a camera
  • Confident solo operator in the field, able to work quickly and unobtrusively in public places
  • Editor with range — fast mobile cuts when speed matters, finished work in Premiere when craft matters
  • Strong editorial instincts about what is worth capturing and what is worth publishing
  • Organized enough to run several accounts, calendars, and shoot schedules without dropping threads
  • Clear communicator who can present work and results to clients and take feedback well

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

  • Own day-to-day social strategy and execution for assigned client accounts
  • Build and maintain content calendars tied to client goals, campaigns, and destination seasonality
  • Capture original photo and vertical video on location, traveling to client destinations
  • Edit and finish content across the full range of speeds — from quick mobile cuts published while still on location, to finished pieces cut in Premiere
  • Publish and schedule across platforms using Odyssey’s publishing stack
  • Manage community engagement day to day — responding, moderating, and escalating per practice standards
  • Monitor performance and deliver recurring reporting with insight and clear recommendations
  • Flag high-performing organic content to the Director and Paid Media for amplification
  • Brief and coordinate creators on assigned accounts, collect deliverables, and track usage rights and disclosure compliance
  • Collect talent releases and location permissions in the field, and keep assets organized and correctly tagged
  • Use AI-assisted tools within the standards and disclosure practices set by the Director
  • Partner with Creative, Production, Paid Media, and Account teams on integrated campaigns
  • Present work, results, and recommendations directly to clients
  • Track platform changes, formats, and trends, and recommend tests worth running
  • Support new business with account audits, content samples, and proposal input

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 4+ years in social media, content production, or a combination of the two
  • A portfolio of vertical video and social content you personally shot and cut
  • Working camera skills — phone-first capture, framing, natural light, and usable audio in the field
  • Editing fluency in both mobile tools and Adobe Premiere Pro; Photoshop, Lightroom, or After Effects a plus
  • Judgment about when speed serves the work and when it does not
  • Ability to read platform analytics and turn them into recommendations, not just recaps
  • Working knowledge of content usage rights, talent releases, FTC disclosure, and music licensing on brand accounts
  • Deep familiarity with Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Pinterest, and LinkedIn
  • Experience with publishing, listening, and analytics tools — Publer, Brand24 or Mention, Meta Business Suite, TikTok Analytics, YouTube Studio, or similar — and comfort learning proprietary internal tooling
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to travel, including occasional weekends and irregular hours around shoots and events
  • Experience in tourism, hospitality, destination marketing, media, or content preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Media, or a related field preferred

HOW WE WORK

This is a remote position with significant field work. Travel to client destinations for production is estimated at 20%+ annually and includes occasional weekends, early mornings, and evenings around shoots and events. On-location work involves carrying camera and audio equipment of approximately 25–30 pounds, extended periods standing and walking, and working outdoors in heat, sun, rain, and marine environments. Remaining work is performed at a computer.

OUR COMMITMENT TO CULTURE:

At Odyssey Studios Group andMiles Partnership, we are driven by our commitment to actively evolve inclusive marketing industry practices, drive innovation within the company and empower our team, our clients and the communities we serve. We will make intentional actions to build a work culture where our team members are always heard, empowered and valued. We will provide a culture of service where we enable our teams and clients to meaningfully engage with their communities, share and tell their stories through travel, and lead a movement across the broader tourism industry to influence social change and ensure open access to travel for all.

Aechelon Technology, a Shield AI company, is a leading producer of 3D simulator content, including Geospecific visual/sensor databases and realistic 3D models. We seek people who share our passion for real-time computer graphics and commitment to our mission of helping make our Nation’s pilots safer. We will give you a chance to work with some of the most talented people in the graphics industry.

Own and continuously improve the Quality Management System (QMS) for Aechelon Technology’s simulation products, programs, and services within Shield AI. Drive quality from development through delivery and support, working across Engineering, Program Management, Operations, Contracts and Procurement to turn requirements into clear actions and verified results.

Serve as the primary quality liaison for customers, suppliers, and subcontracts. Ensure customer quality commitments flow down to suppliers and subcontractors and are met throughout execution, with Aechelon retaining accountability for subcontracted work.

This is an individual-contributor role that leads through subject-matter expertise, cross-functional influence, and process ownership, with no direct people-management responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Management System

  • Maintain QMS policies, procedures, records, and objective evidence appropriate to software, hardware, simulation, and systems integration.
  • Plan and conduct risk-based internal, program, supplier, and subcontractor audits; support customer and third-party assessments, including audits required to maintain ISO 9001:2015 certification.
  • Coordinate with responsible functions to incorporate applicable contractual, regulatory, cybersecurity, export-control, configuration-management, and documentation requirements into quality planning.
  • Establish measurable quality objectives and KPIs, and regularly report quality performance, trends, significant risks, and recommended actions to Aechelon Technology and Shield AI leadership.
  • Use quality data, audit findings, and lessons learned to identify systemic issues, prioritize process improvements, and verify their effectiveness.

Customer and Program Quality

  • Serve as a primary customer quality contract and coordinate responses to customer quality inquiries, Corrective Action Requests (CARs), nonconformances, and quality concerns.
  • Ensure required quality documentation, certifications, inspection records, test results, and other deliverables are complete and provided to customers as required.
  • Partner with Program Management and functional-teams to incorporate customer quality commitments into program execution and verified completion before customer acceptance and delivery.

Subcontractor and Supplier Quality

  • Identify applicable customer requirements and work with Contracts, Procurement, Engineering, and Program Management to incorporate them into subcontracts, purchase orders, statements of work, and supplier quality clauses.
  • Define expectations for processes, documentation, inspection, testing, configuration control, traceability, reporting, and acceptance.
  • Assess supplier capability, technical competency, quality performance, and risk; establish scorecards and monitor performance throughout execution.
  • Conduct appropriate audits, source inspections, and surveillance; review inspection, test, acceptance, and quality records before accepting deliverables.
  • Require documented root-cause analysis and corrective action for nonconformances; verify closure and effectiveness. Escalate recurring issues and coordinate probation, remediation, disqualification, or replacement as needed.

Nonconformance and Corrective Action Management

  • Establish and administer processes for documenting, investigating, dispositioning, and closing nonconforming products, software, documentation, or services within established approval authorities.
  • Lead Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) activities, including structured root-cause analysis for significant or recurring internal and customer quality issues; track resulting corrective actions to closure and verify their effectiveness.
  • Analyze quality data to identify systemic trends and recurring failure modes.

Leadership and Cross-Functional Responsibilities

  • Coordinate quality execution across functional teams, establishing agreed deliverables, milestones and dependencies.
  • Track quality commitments and escalate missed milestones, unresolved issues, and resource constraints to the appropriate leaders.
  • Provide training and guidance to employees regarding quality processes, customer requirements, subcontractor quality expectations, and continuous improvement.
  • Escalate significant quality risks when contractual commitments, customer satisfaction, safety, schedule, or product performance may be affected.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, quality management, business administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Experience supporting simulation, aerospace, defense, or other complex hardware/software products.
  • Experience serving as a primary quality contact for customers and supporting external certification audits.
  • ISO 9001 lead auditor training or certification, ASQ Certified Quality Engineer, ASQ Certified Quality Auditor, or a related quality credential.

Benefits

We offer a very attractive compensation package including competitive base salary, company performance-based profit sharing, 401k, 100% employer paid health benefits (medical, dental, vision, life, std, ltd, and life insurance plans).

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title:  Program Manager

Position Location:  Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Job Summary

The Program Manager is a strategic position accountable for leading all aspects of a collection of projects (i.e. Program). This person will work as part of the project team and interact closely with the owner, designers, contractors, subcontractors and other trades on mission critical projects and other department initiatives as required.

On a per project basis, the role may include managing the design and construction administration phases of projects either directly, or through direction provided to Project Managers. These duties may include performing site visits, leading, and representing DLB in client meetings, coordinating with internal and external members, and general project overhead tasks.

The Program Manager  will be self-directed on day-to-day work and independently performs most responsibilities.  Will lead project teams of complex scope and broader programs. Will coordinate activities of other personnel.  Assists in the development of policies and procedures.

The Program Manager will communicate and operate in line with organizational and client goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

Essential Functions

Manage all Elements of Routine and Complex Projects (40%)

  • Drive project design from inception (site acquisition) through design and construction with a high-level focus on Client Standards and overall application across multiple projects.
  • Develop owner project requirements (OPR) and initial space planning efforts / schematic design
  • Schedule and sometimes represent DLB at site visits including existing condition surveys and punchlists
  • Coordinate between internal design trades and external team members
  • Manage directly or oversee DLB Project Managers to manage the construction administration phase of projects including RFI responses, submittal reviews, and change order reviews
  • Coordinate and support resource forecasting across the design program
  • Develop, manage and monitor project schedules
  • Participate in, schedule, and / or lead project meetings with internal and external teams
  • Coordinate / perform QA / QC plans and specifications to ensure completion in accordance with the project scope and appropriate guidelines and manuals
  • Oversee / coordinate internal team member activities
  • Oversee cost and time schedules for proposed work with the aid of team leaders. Assign and schedule duties to project team members.

Monitor and Control Project Financials (15%)

  • Prepare, forecast and monitor project budgets, profitability, margins, bill rates and utilization and maintain overall accountability for the profitability of the project
  • Communicate with the client when additional fees / change orders are required
  • Identify potential project risks and develop / implement strategies to minimize impact and control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines
  • Accountable for development of cost schedules / schedules of value for client progress billing

Manage Stakeholder Relations (25%)

  • Lead preparation of proposals, presentations and the overall marketing efforts of the firm
  • Lead the promotion of the firm, service and expertise to existing or potential clients
  • Maintain client relationship to ensure an ongoing positive relationship and work with clients to identify and develop new projects
  • Primary contact for clients and build effective, long-term client relationships
  • Ensure client satisfaction through active communication
  • Create / complete program reports

Development and Continuous Improvement (20%)

  • Mentor associates and assist with training and development to create a learning and growing environment
  • May assist or lead in the strategic planning for the group
  • May assist with hiring process
  • May assist or lead other department initiatives including development and standardization of tools relating to client management, business development, project / program profitability, workload / resource planning, etc.
  • May have direct reports / people manager responsibilities
  • Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency

  • Identify opportunities and lead the strategic use of technology, digital platforms, and AI-enabled tools to enhance efficiency through workflow automation, reduced manual effort, and improved accuracy in forecasting, documentation, reporting, and quality processes.
  • Support adoption of emerging technologies - including advanced analytics, data visualization tools, and digital construction management platforms - to strengthen readiness, quality assurance, and project controls.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure technology solutions align with DLB standards for data security, privacy, and operational integrity.
  • Promote a culture that embraces innovation, continuous improvement, and the strategic use of technology to optimize performance and scalability.

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

Position Requirements (Advanced level for all the following)

  • Knowledge of industry trends, project management and construction procedures and best practices
  • Knowledge of business and management principles involved in strategic planning, resource allocation, leadership technique, production methods and coordination of people and resources
  • ​Knowledge of materials, methods and the tools involved in the construction mission critical, commercial buildings or other structures
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
  • Skilled at using construction management software such as Procore
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
  • Skilled at managing personnel and material resources
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, optimize operational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation.
  • Ability to effectively plan and delegate the work of others
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
  • Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)
  • Ability to communicate effectively directly with clients and at times serve as primary point of client contact
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with onsite and remote team members
  • Ability to effectively plan and delegate the work of others
  • Ability to analyze complex information and develop plans to address identified issues

Physical Demands

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving through office, facility and other environments
  • On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds

Travel Requirements

  • Approximately 10%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meeting for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

Education / Experience

  • B.A. / B.S. degree in engineering, construction or related discipline

OR

PLUS

  • Minimum of thirteen years of experience in related field
  • Minimum of five years of experience managing mid to large scale construction, engineering, or manufacturing projects

Benefits

Senior PM/Principal PM - Host team

Peerspace is the leading and category defining online marketplace for venue rentals for meetings, productions, and events. We open doors to the most inspiring spaces around the world, from lofts and mansions to storefronts and studios. Over $500M has been transacted through the platform, and our investors include GV (Google Ventures) and Foundation Capital.

Our people are the heart of Peerspace. We are a team that values inclusion and working cross functionally. Our strategy and objectives are clear and we support one another to exceed expectations. We believe that a healthy company culture creates an environment where people are excited to come into work everyday and contribute to building a successful organization.

The Role

The Senior Product Manager (level flexible) in this role will own the host (supply) side of our marketplace - everything that helps hosts list, get activated, and run a thriving business on Peerspace. It's a wide-ranging remit spanning host onboarding and activation, listing quality, and the host tools that power day-to-day management (messaging, availability, scheduling).

We're looking for someone who has lived and breathed two-sided marketplaces and knows that great supply is what makes them work. You'll get to know our hosts firsthand - their businesses, their workflows, and what's frustrating them - then turn those pain points into solutions that keep them transacting on the platform.

As we expand the services and tools we offer hosts, you'll shape the long-term strategy for host success and, just as importantly, drive the execution that turns it into shipped, measurable impact. Our team is small but mighty - so you'll be able to make a ton of impact quickly, and help chart the future direction of the company.

What you'll do

  • Get close to our hosts: talk with them regularly, spend time in the data and in CX conversations, and build a deep understanding of their pain points, how our marketplace works today, competitors and market trends.

  • Translate what you learn into creative, well-scoped solutions - balancing host needs with guest experience and overall marketplace health.

  • Proactively engage the right stakeholders - including host-facing teams like CX and Supply Operations - to inform decisions and keep them aligned throughout development, not just at launch.

  • Own business outcomes end-to-end: define the metrics that matter, instrument them, and be accountable for moving them - not just for shipping features.

  • Present multiple options with a clear recommendation, hold your own with executives, and engage in constructive disagreement when it serves the customer and the business.

  • Drive execution and ensure your cross-functional teams deliver customer value and desired business outcomes effectively.

Who you are

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience in a two-sided marketplace, ideally focused on the supply side. You understand marketplace dynamics and have shipped products that moved them.

  • Deeply customer-obsessed: you seek out conversations with users, get energized by understanding them, and have a track record of turning those insights into products they love.

  • Creative and entrepreneurial problem solver who can go from high-level opportunity to detailed plan to successful execution. You are great at energizing teams, building product roadmaps and collaborating with engineering, design, marketing and operations to make it happen.

  • Track record of owning measurable business outcomes - able to articulate the “so what” behind past launches and the impact they drove, not just the features shipped.

  • Confident presenting multiple options with a clear point of view, influencing executives and cross-functional partners, and giving and receiving direct feedback.

  • Inclusive, open-minded, self-aware and eager to continuously learn. You have a passion for product and are genuinely excited about Peerspace's mission.

Working At Peerspace

The annual salary range for this role is $155,000-$170,000 . The actual salary amount will vary depending on the applicant’s experience, skills, and abilities as well as internal equity and market data.

Peerspace is proudly certified as a Great Place to Work™ and we're a remote first company with team members located in cities around the globe. Beyond competitive salary and equity compensation, we provide a range of benefits and perks, including:

● 100% employee coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance

● Discount on all Peerspace bookings

● Laptop, high res display, and stipend to setup home office

● Monthly cell phone and internet credit

● Annual In person all company offsite and team-building events (in Peerspace locations, of course)

● Wellness Days observed company wide

Diversity

At Peerspace, we're dedicated to creating a team that's diverse, equitable and inclusive. Our workplace is a space where all team members are empowered to blaze their own trail, make things happen, and take pride in their work. We believe bringing people together from different backgrounds and identities makes us stronger and better serves the Peerspace community. We'd especially like to encourage applicants from different backgrounds, locations, and experiences.

At Peerspace, we are committed to maintaining a secure and transparent hiring experience. jobs.description:
The Learning & Development Head will lead the design, development, and execution of a scalable, structured learning strategy that supports the growth of teleoperators and operational teams in a roboticsdriven environment.

This role is responsible for ensuring strong adherence to established processes and the effective communication of these processes across the organization, translating complex operational workflows into clear, structured, and actionable training modules. Rather than driving process creation, the LD Head will focus on breaking down existing processes into micro-steps, enabling effective onboarding and capability development—particularly for pilots performing highly technical and physical teleoperation tasks, including navigation of complex background workflows.

The L&D Head will directly oversee Operations Analysts, who serve as subject matter experts in data annotation, technical writing, and teleoperations coaching. In partnership with them, this role will ensure that technical knowledge is transformed into scalable learning programs, standardized training materials, and practical modules that accelerate operator readiness and performance. Beyond content development, the role will champion a culture of continuous learning and capability building, ensuring that opportunities for growth are readily accessible to employees. The L&D Head will work toward equipping employees with the right training resources and learning pathways to help them reach their full potential, while aligning individual development with organizational growth objectives. This role is also expected to design and implement tailored learning programs that deliver measurable impact, continuously exploring new training methodologies, tools, and global L&D trends. Through the execution of structured learning strategies and the tracking of their effectiveness, the L&D Head will ensure that training initiatives contribute directly to performance improvement, workforce readiness, and long-term organizational success. This role reports directly to the General Manager and works in close collaboration with key leaders across Operations, People & Culture, and other core functions to ensure alignment of learning initiatives with business objectives and operational priorities.

  • Health Insurance/HMO
  • Enjoy unlimited MadMax Coffee
  • Diverse learning & growth opportunities
  • Accessible Cloud HR platform (Sprout)
  • Above standard leaves

I - Learning Strategy & Framework Design:

  • Design and implement a comprehensive L&D framework aligned with business goals, operational scalability, and workforce capability requirements;
  • Establish competency frameworks and skill progression pathways (e.g., Good → Elite performance levels);
  • Develop structured learning roadmaps and an end-to-end Teleoperator Learning Framework for teleoperators, analysts, and future leaders, including SOP-based training modules, step-bystep task playbooks, annotation guidelines, training videos, and assessment materials tailored to different operator job levels;
  • Develop an Operator Readiness Scorecard and Metrics to objectively assess operator competency across skill levels (Neutral, Good, Elite);
  • Establish Continuous Feedback Loops that translate operational performance data, teleoperator accuracy, and process insights into ongoing updates and improvements to training content and modules.
  • Industry Trends: Stay current on emerging technical skills, tools, and practices in technology-driven operational environments to ensure training programs remain
    relevant and effective.

II - Training Needs Assessment & Skill Gap Analysis:

  • Execute Training Needs Analysis with key stakeholders to serve as the
    foundation for learning and development initiatives;
  • Conduct thorough assessments of current operator skills across all job levels, from Entry-level to Elite/Customer-facing roles, to identify knowledge and competency gaps;
  • Design targeted, role-specific training programs to bridge identified gaps, ensuring content is relevant to each operator level (Neutral, Good, Elite);
  • Create modular learning pathways that progressively develop skills, allowing operators to advance from foundational knowledge to advanced operational expertise;
  • Incorporate practical exercises, scenario-based training, and simulations aligned with real-world teleoperations and robotic workflows;
  • Analyze performance metrics and operational outcomes to pinpoint specific areas where training is required;

III - Capability Building & Workforce Development:

  • Lead initiatives to build technical and operational capabilities across teleoperators and support teams;
  • Ensure effective training on data annotation, robotic tele-operations, and process workflows;
  • Collaborate with Operations Managers and Operations Analysts to ensure technical training content is accurate, relevant, and comprehensive;
  • Develop programs for leadership pipeline, coaching capability, and performance improvement;
  • Drive learning interventions that support performance gaps and operational needs.

IV - Learning Evaluation and Performance Management:

  • Track and analyze performance improvements of operators across all job levels (Neutral, Good, Elite) following completion of technical training programs;
  • Measure productivity gains, accuracy in teleoperations, and adherence to standardized processes to assess the effectiveness of learning initiatives;
  • Collect qualitative and quantitative feedback from operators, team leads, and operations analysts to evaluate training relevance and applicability;
  • Generate regular reports for senior leadership highlighting skill development, performance improvements, and areas for further enhancement;
  • Continuously evaluate the effectiveness of training interventions through assessments, feedback, and operational OKRs to ensure measurable improvement in operator performance.

V - Content Structuring & Instructional Design:

  • Translate technical inputs from Operations Analysts into structured training modules and programs;
  • Oversee the conversion of SOPs, annotation processes, and workflows into digestible learning content;
  • Implement instructional design best practices (modular learning, microlearning, blended learning approaches);
  • Drive the development of scalable onboarding and continuous learning programs;
  • Ensure all training materials are standardized, version-controlled, and audit-ready.

VI - Training Delivery Oversight & Coaching Excellence

  • Oversee the delivery of training programs, ensuring consistency, quality, and
    alignment with operational standards;
  • Establish coaching frameworks and methodologies to support skill development and operator growth;
  • Lead live training sessions and Simulation Labs, demonstrating new methodologies and guiding operators through teleoperation tasks, data annotation, and workflow scenarios;
  • Manage the teleoperation training environment, both physical and virtual, ensuring it reflects professional and safety standards;
  • Integrate hands-on workshops with digital learning platforms to track operator performance, progress, and competency metrics effectively.

VII - Data, Insights & Continuous Improvement

  • Utilize data and performance insights to refine learning programs and improve outcomes;
  • Ensure alignment between training outputs and operational OKRs;
  • Drive continuous improvement by integrating feedback from operations, US counterparts, and system performance;
  • Maintain learning dashboards and reporting mechanisms for leadership visibility.

VIII - Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with People & Culture, Operations teams, and BPO partners to ensure training content is accurate, technically sound, and fully aligned with current workflows.
  • Gather input from subject matter experts (PH and US Teams) to identify realworld challenges and integrate them into training modules;
  • Scale the Learning & Development team as teleoperation programs mature and expand;
  • Directly manage the Operations Analysts and develop their skills to become
    effective trainers through a "train-the-trainer" approach;
  • Prepare Site Leads and Team Leads to transition from day-to-day operational tasks to leadership responsibilities, focusing on coaching, process oversight, and developing long-term team capability as workflows become standardized and repeatable;
  • Design and implement ongoing upskilling programs for experienced operators and analysts to enhance proficiency and career growth;
  • Maintain ongoing communication with key stakeholders to update content as processes, tools, and technologies evolve;
  • Ensure that technical training programs address practical operational issues and prepare employees to perform effectively in live teleoperation environments.
  • 10+ years of experience in Learning & Development, Training, or Talent Enablement, with at least 5 years focused on technical training in high-growth, tech-driven operational environments, complemented by prior leadership experience in operations-focused organizations or BPOs.
  • Solid experience leading Learning & Development initiatives, with a proven track record in designing, implementing, and delivering comprehensive learning programs that drive business results and employee growth;
  • Proven track record of building training programs from the ground up, including curriculum design, instructional frameworks, facilitation, and quality assurance;
  • Experience assessing performance issues, designing and implementing solutions, facilitating interventions, supporting HR enablement, and evaluating outcomes;
  • Hands-on experience leading instructor-led training in both in-person and hybrid formats, translating complex technical processes into structured, scalable learning programs;
  • Solid understanding of how adults learn, how to measure skills, and how to use learning platforms to help operators grow and stay ready;
  • Experience in collaborating with stakeholders to ensure learning programs align with business objectives;
  • Proven data-driven mindset, leveraging business metrics, surveys, employee feedback, and best practices to shape learning strategies and enhance employee development;
  • Strong proficiency in online learning platforms, multimedia training systems, e-learning authoring tools, visual presentation software, and survey tools;
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage and coach teams across multiple levels;
  • Proven ability to design competency frameworks, performance-based learning programs, and upskilling initiatives to leverage skills and support the growth of emerging leaders;
  • Additional relevant knowledge or experience related to the above requirements will be considered an advantage.

JHNA, CTSi, and EXPANSIA have come together to form a Defense Technology platform named Aether Aerospace focused on delivering high-impact technologies, technology-enabled services and advanced manufacturing solutions to the U.S. Department of Defense and related national security customers. The combined organization operates as a multi-entity aerospace and defense technology and tech-enabled services and manufacturing enterprise positioned for scalable growth, operational excellence, and long-term value creation

OVERVIEW

Full-time/Permanent Employee

Location: Remote
As a Software Factory Engineer III, you will implement and aid mission software teams in the onboarding and use of software factory capabilities. You will integrate development tools, cloud services, CI/CD pipelines, security controls, and observability into reliable workflows, using reusable templates and automation to reduce the effort required to onboard applications. You will work with programs that use established Department of the Air Force software factories, such as Platform One, ODIN, and DAF CloudWorks, and help teams navigate their onboarding, access, application integration, security, and release processes. Working under general direction, you will independently resolve complex technical issues and collaborate with developers, cybersecurity personnel, and government stakeholders to improve the developer experience and delivery outcomes.

    • Integrate source control, CI/CD, artifact repositories, container registries, automated testing, security scanning, secrets management, and observability into software delivery workflows

    • Automate builds, tests, vulnerability checks, artifact promotion, deployments, and operational monitoring across development, test, and production environments

    • Implement security controls and evidence collection within delivery workflows in coordination with cybersecurity and RMF/ATO teams; address application-specific control responsibilities and findings

    • Provision and configure cloud and container services, including identity, networking, storage, compute, Kubernetes, and secrets, within approved environments

    • Troubleshoot onboarding, integration, pipeline, deployment, and performance issues; document fixes and improve the shared platform

    • Create self-service documentation, examples, and onboarding guidance so development teams can use factory capabilities effectively

    • Provide technical guidance to application teams on factory tools, DevSecOps practices, and secure releases

    • Maintain configuration standards, monitor service health and delivery metrics, and improve reliability and developer experience

    • Provide technical support to operational strategies aligned within your program and initiatives that optimize processes, enhance productivity, and ensure quality across all program functions

    • Ensure 100% of planned hours are worked and recorded

    • Identify and forward to your leadership any opportunities that could lead to growth within your work area

    • Participate in growth efforts as requested

    • Ensure all contractual deliverables are met/exceeded to the customer's satisfaction

    • Complete personal PDP and attend Staff Meeting and Storytime (with camera on)

    • Within your program, build productive and positive professional relationships with clients

    • Execute all contract requirements as assigned in accordance with the contract-specific LCAT and requirements

    • Perform other related duties as assigned

KEY QUALIFICATIONS

    Clearance:Active TS/SCI
    Education and Years of Experience:Bachelor's (or equivalent) with 5 - 7 years of experience, or a Master's and 3 to 5 years of experience in software factory engineering, DevSecOps, cloud/platform engineering, IT operations, or software development

    • Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines, automated tests, artifact workflows, and reusable delivery templates

    • Experience onboarding or supporting applications in an established software factory or shared development platform, including access, toolchain integration, and release workflows

    • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation and scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell

    • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes

    • Understanding of DevSecOps security scanning, vulnerability remediation, monitoring, and the application team’s role in RMF/ATO processes

PREFERRED ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

    • Experience using Platform One, ODIN, DAF CloudWorks, or a comparable DoD software factory as an application team member or onboarding engineer

    • Experience with artifact repositories, hardened containers, SBOMs, secrets management, and software supply-chain controls

    • Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or ELK Stack

    • Experience creating developer documentation or self-service onboarding workflows for multiple teams

    • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and responsibly integrating AI-assisted or agentic development tools into delivery workflows

    • Familiarity with AI-assisted development and agentic workflows, including coding agents, MCP integrations, automated tests, and documentation, with human review and configuration control

Location

Our GTM Systems Engineer will be an integral part of our Enterprise Systems team. This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, or Sweden. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal.

The OpportunityWe're looking for an engineering-minded owner of the systems our Sales, Marketing and Revenue Operations teams run on: CRM, marketing automation, CPQ and the tools around them. This is not a ticket-queue role. Business teams will bring you solutions ("add a field", "build me a report"). Your job is to find the problem behind the request and see how a change affects every connected system. Then fix it once, ideally so the next person can do it themselves without filing a request. You'll have an internal engineering team to lean on, and you'll use AI tools daily to build faster.

Responsibilities

  • Own the GTM systems as one connected whole: know how CRM, CPQ, marketing automation and sales-engagement tools share data, and design every change with that in view.
  • Turn requests into problems: ask what the business is trying to solve, propose options, explain trade-offs, and say "no" or "not like that" when it's the right call.
