The Sustainability team at Everlane is responsible for developing and executing the sustainability strategy to ‘Keep Earth Clean, Keep Earth Cool, and Do Right by People’ across the company’s value chain and operations. Our strategy encompasses our social impact and environmental responsibility efforts and goals across the materials we use, the factories we partner with, the way our stores and offices operate, and how we foster thoughtful transparency throughout our supply chain. The team is highly cross-functional, collaborating regularly with Supply Chain and Product teams, Marketing and Creative, Retail Ops, EPDD, and external suppliers, vendors, and industry organizations.

The Senior Manager of Sustainability will report to the VP of Product Development and Sourcing and play a key role in driving the execution and evolution of Everlane’s sustainability strategy. You will focus on delivering against current commitments—including Renew, Organic Cotton, and carbon reduction—while supporting the development of future initiatives in partnership with cross-functional teams.

You will work closely with Raw Materials, Product Development, Sourcing, Marketing, and external partners to integrate sustainability into product creation, vendor management, and brand storytelling. This role balances hands-on program ownership with cross-functional influence, ensuring sustainability goals are actionable, measurable, and embedded across the business.

Your day-to-day:

  • Own the execution of Everlane’s sustainability roadmap across key pillars including climate, water, waste, and circularity
  • Drive progress against existing commitments (e.g., Renew, Organic Cotton, carbon footprint reduction), ensuring clear tracking and accountability
  • Translate high-level sustainability goals into actionable programs, timelines, and deliverables
  • Partner with Raw Materials and Product Development to integrate lower-impact materials and processes into product lines
  • Partner with factories, mills, and third-party vendors to ensure alignment with Everlane’s environmental and social standards
  • Support and evolve vendor compliance programs, including data collection, performance tracking, and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Own the development of quarterly and annual sustainability reporting, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and clarity
  • Support implementation and management of systems to track environmental and social compliance data
  • Partner with Marketing and Creative to support sustainability storytelling, including updates to the sustainability website
  • Collaborate with Workplace and Retail teams to embed sustainability practices across physical spaces
  • Provide regular updates to internal stakeholders and leadership on progress and key initiatives

As a Principal Engineer at Fuze Health/FuzeRx, you are a top-tier technical leader and individual contributor who drives the overarching technical vision and architectural strategy across our engineering organization. Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you will operate across multiple product squads, guiding the design and execution of our most complex, mission-critical systems. By setting the standard for engineering excellence and leveraging our core stack (AWS, PostgreSQL, Ruby on Rails, Python, and TypeScript/JavaScript), you will ensure our digital pharmacy, API-powered fulfillment, and patient care platforms are highly scalable, performant, and secure. This role is essential to our mission, directly enabling FuzeRx to process high volumes of healthcare transactions reliably while maintaining strict compliance and improving patient outcomes.

  • Architectural Vision & Strategy: Define and evolve the target architecture for FuzeRx’s core B2B and consumer platforms. Drive the technical roadmap to transition legacy systems into modern, scalable, and highly cohesive architectures.

jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Product team

The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.

About the role

Millions of people use the Affirm Card, but we don’t yet give them a reason to keep coming back beyond the product itself. You’ll build our consumer loyalty program from scratch: what people earn, how they move up, and why Affirm becomes their default way to pay.

What you’ll do

  • Own the vision and roadmap for Affirm’s consumer loyalty program, setting the hypotheses, success metrics, and sequencing across multiple quarters

  • Launch the first version of rewards and tiers, including earn mechanics, member benefits, redemption, and the surfaces that make the value obvious in app, at checkout, and after a purchase

  • Build the engagement loops (progress, milestones, personalized offers) that turn a one-time borrower into someone who reaches for Affirm every week

  • Own the program economics: reward liability, funding mix across merchant-funded offers, interchange and network incentives, and the case for incremental GMV against cost per member

  • Set up the measurement foundation for loyalty, including holdouts, incrementality testing and long-run LTV, then tune earn and burn rates and tier thresholds off what the data says

  • Partner with Risk, Credit, Legal, Compliance, Finance and Marketing to design rewards that are compliant and clearly disclosed, with no hidden fees or fine print that surprises people

  • Align senior stakeholders and pull together dependencies across Card, Shopping, Servicing and Marketing, leading embedded engineering and design pods through a lot of ambiguity

What we look for

  • 8+ years in Product Management, with a track record in consumer mobile apps, fintech, or neobanks

  • Built or scaled a loyalty, rewards or engagement program: card rewards, points, tiers, subscription benefits, or something equivalent. You know earn and burn mechanics and what makes a program pay for itself

  • History of launching products from scratch, not just optimizing what already exists

  • Owned repeat usage, cohort retention or share of wallet as a primary metric, and know which levers actually move them

  • Comfortable building the financial model yourself and defending reward cost, funding mix and payback to Finance and leadership

  • Strong UX instincts and a high bar for design. You know the difference between a reward that feels good and a badge buried in a settings menu

  • Deep fluency in experiment design, incrementality/attribution, and LTV measurement; data chops (SQL/Amplitude-level self-serve) and a bias for shipping, learning and iterating quickly

  • Track record shipping consumer financial or regulated products; comfort partnering with Risk/Credit, Legal, and Compliance

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership, including experience leading without authority

  • AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and others to research, analyze and prototype, and help develop better product vision

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience

Base Pay Grade - P

Equity Grade - 7

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

CAN base pay range per year: $181,000 - $241,000

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.excerpt: EN will followÀ propos d’Akinox Akinox est une entreprise canadienne de santé numérique qui vise à améliorer l’accès des patients aux soins ainsi que la façon dont les organisations de santé les offrent.
jobs.description:
EN will follow

À propos d’Akinox

Akinox est une entreprise canadienne de santé numérique qui vise à améliorer l’accès des patients aux soins ainsi que la façon dont les organisations de santé les offrent. Depuis plus de 15 ans, Akinox collabore avec des organisations de santé et des gouvernements afin de concevoir et d’exploiter des solutions de santé numérique à grande échelle. Nos activités couvrent notamment les soins de première ligne, les soins virtuels, l’accès aux soins et la transformation des processus cliniques.

Le rôle

Nous recherchons une personne rigoureuse et organisée pour soutenir et coordonner les activités de conformité, de sécurité de l’information et de gouvernance de l’organisation. Un intérêt marqué pour l’intelligence artificiel sera considéré comme un important atout.

Dans ce rôle à temps partiel (3 jours/semaine), vous serez responsable du maintien des activités courantes de conformité et contribuerez aux différents cycles d’audit, de gestion des risques et de certification. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes de sécurité, technologie, produit et opérations, ainsi qu’avec différents partenaires externes.

Principales responsabilités

  • Administrer et maintenir le programme de conformité et la plateforme GRC, incluant les contrôles, preuves et suivis.
  • Maintenir le registre des risques et assurer le suivi des vulnérabilités, non-conformités, mesures correctives et échéances.
  • Maintenir et mettre à jour les politiques, procédures et contrôles de conformité.
  • Coordonner la préparation aux audits, certifications et autres activités de conformité, notamment ISO 27001 et ISO 9001.
  • Maintenir les indicateurs requis pour les objectifs ISO 27001 et les activités liées à ISO 9001, et préparer les éléments nécessaires aux revues de gestion.
  • Coordonner les tests d’intrusion, attestations et autres évaluations de sécurité lorsque requis.
  • Soutenir la gouvernance des changements et les exigences de conformité associées aux mises en production.
  • Participer aux évaluations de risques liées aux nouveaux fournisseurs, partenaires, intégrations et projets.
  • Faire un suivi 60-90 jours à l’avance des audits, attestations, tests d’intrusion, revues d’accès, renouvellement et besoins de preuves.
  • Effectuer les suivis auprès des propriétaires de contrôles, risques, non-conformités et actions correctives afin que les éléments soient complétés dans les délais.
  • Soutenir les demandes de clients et prospects en matière de sécurité, confidentialité et conformité, incluant les RFP et activités de diligence raisonnable.
  • Coordonner les évaluations d’impact sur la vie privée (EFVP/PIA) et l’évaluation des risques associés aux nouveaux outils ou usages de l’intelligence artificielle.
  • Administrer les activités de formation et de sensibilisation en sécurité et conformité.
  • Effectuer une veille réglementaire et identifier les nouvelles exigences nécessitant une action.
  • Coordonner les activités de conformité lors d’incidents de confidentialité ou de sécurité.

Profil recherché

  • 2 à 5 ans d’expérience pertinente dans le domaine des TI.
  • Expérience en conformité, gouvernance, gestion des risques, sécurité de l’information ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Démontre une forte aisance technologique et une facilité à apprendre de nouveaux outils.
  • Bonne compréhension des processus d’audit et de gestion de la conformité.
  • Connaissance des normes ISO 27001 et ISO 9001, un atout important.
  • Expérience dans le domaine de la santé ou dans un environnement hautement réglementé.
  • Grand intérêt envers les nouvelles technologies, l’intelligence artificielle et l’automatisation.
  • À l’aise avec le suivi des indicateurs de performance (KPIs) et la préparation de rapport; une expérience en « reporting » constitue un atout.
  • Excellente gestion des priorités, dossiers, échéances, exigences, etc.
  • Faire preuve de curiosité et de volonté d’apprentissage.
  • Bon esprit d’analyse et capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités.
  • Excellentes habiletés de communication orale et écrite en français et en anglais.

ENGLISH

About Akinox

Akinox is a Canadian digital health company that aims to improve patients' access to care and the way healthcare organizations deliver it. For over 15 years, Akinox has collaborated with healthcare organizations and governments to design and operate large-scale digital health solutions. Our activities include primary care, virtual care, access to care, and the transformation of clinical processes.

The Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized individual to support and coordinate the organization's compliance, information security, and governance activities. A strong interest in artificial intelligence will be considered a significant asset.

In this part-time role (3 days/week), you will be responsible for maintaining ongoing compliance activities and contributing to various audit, risk management, and certification cycles. You will work closely with the security, technology, product, and operations teams, as well as various external partners.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and maintain the compliance program and GRC platform, including controls, evidence, and follow-ups.
  • Maintain the risk register and track vulnerabilities, non-conformities, corrective actions, and deadlines.
  • Maintain and update compliance policies, procedures, and controls.
  • Coordinate preparations for audits, certifications, and other compliance activities, including ISO 27001 and ISO 9001.
  • Maintain the indicators required for ISO 27001 objectives and ISO 9001-related activities, and prepare the necessary materials for management reviews.
  • Coordinate penetration testing, attestations, and other security assessments as required.
  • Support change governance and compliance requirements associated with production deployments.
  • Participate in risk assessments related to new vendors, partners, integrations, and projects.
  • Conduct follow-ups 60–90 days in advance of audits, attestations, penetration tests, access reviews, renewals, and evidence requirements.
  • Follow up with owners of controls, risks, non-conformities, and corrective actions to ensure items are completed within the required deadlines.
  • Support client and prospect requests related to security, privacy, and compliance, including RFPs and due diligence activities.
  • Coordinate Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) and risk assessments associated with new artificial intelligence tools or use cases.
  • Administer security and compliance training and awareness activities.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and identify new requirements that require action.
  • Coordinate compliance activities during privacy or security incidents.

Qualifications

  • 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in the IT field.
  • Experience in compliance, governance, risk management, information security, or a related field.
  • Demonstrates strong technological proficiency and the ability to quickly learn new tools.
  • Good understanding of audit and compliance management processes.
  • Knowledge of ISO 27001 and ISO 9001 standards is a significant asset.
  • Experience in the healthcare sector or a highly regulated environment.
  • Strong interest in emerging technologies, artificial intelligence, and automation.
  • Comfortable tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) and preparing reports; experience in reporting is an asset.
  • Excellent ability to manage priorities, files, deadlines, requirements, etc.
  • Demonstrates curiosity and a willingness to learn.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in French and English.

Enrollment Specialists are measured on objective, clearly defined metrics, including:

Why This Role Matters

For many families, the Enrollment Specialist is their first human interaction with Ceresti. Caregivers often reach us feeling overwhelmed, unsure, or skeptical. The way enrollment conversations are handled directly impacts caregiver trust, program engagement, and long-term outcomes.

You will have three mandates:

Location: Remote, with mission-driven travel. Travel volume varies considerably by season and program; we’re happy to discuss specifics with candidates.

Job Type: Full-Time

About Somewear Labs

Somewear Labs builds communication and unmanned systems technology for mission-critical operations in challenging environments.

Job Summary

The Mission Support Engineer – Networking is a hands-on, forward-deployed technical expert who owns the success of our communications and networking deployments — from pre-mission preparation through execution and recovery. You will translate mission requirements into working network architectures, diagnose problems in austere conditions, and enable operators to use the capability confidently on their own.

Key Responsibilities

Mission Support & Field Execution

  • Own technical execution of communications and networking deployments, including trials, evaluations, demonstrations, exercises, and operational missions.

  • Serve as the on-site technical owner for network readiness, configuration, troubleshooting, and mission performance.

  • Conduct pre-mission checks, equipment preparation, configuration, and readiness assessments; support post-mission recovery, documentation, and after-action review.

  • Translate mission requirements into practical connectivity and network architecture.

  • Drive issues to resolution in the field using structured troubleshooting and sound engineering judgment rather than escalation.

Network Engineering & Troubleshooting

  • Configure, operate, maintain, and troubleshoot mission networking and communications equipment.

  • Troubleshoot IP addressing and subnetting, routing, NAT, DHCP, DNS, VPNs, tunnels, encrypted overlays, and firewall and traffic filtering rules.

  • Diagnose MTU, latency, packet loss, and constrained-bandwidth problems, and capture and analyze traffic using tools such as tcpdump and Wireshark.

  • Deploy and troubleshoot video streaming over constrained and contested links, including RTSP, RTP/UDP, SRT, MPEG-TS, WebRTC, and HLS; H.264/H.265 encoding; and ONVIF-compliant cameras and encoders.

  • Tune video streams for available bandwidth and latency budgets — bitrate, resolution, GOP and keyframe interval, buffering, multicast versus unicast — and resolve firewall, NAT traversal, and transcoding issues affecting feeds to ATAK, ground control stations, and downstream consumers.

  • Work with RF communications and satellite or other beyond-line-of-sight connectivity as the mission requires.

Linux, Software & Automation

  • Administer and troubleshoot Linux from the command line: processes and services, logs, network interfaces, routing tables, firewall rules, permissions, packages and dependencies, and system resource utilization.

  • Work with APIs, configuration files, logs, and command-line tools to configure systems and diagnose mission issues.

  • Build temporary diagnostic tools, scripts, or workarounds when needed to isolate a problem or keep a mission moving.

Customer Enablement & Product Feedback

  • Train operators on network setup, communications workflows, and troubleshooting, and support onboarding into operational use.

  • Advise customers on incorporating the technology into SOPs, CONOPs, and training pipelines, and deliver technical briefs and demonstrations covering capabilities and limitations.

  • Synthesize operator feedback and field observations for Product and Engineering, and help validate new capabilities and integrations prior to launch.

Qualifications

Required

  • Hands-on, engineering-level experience diagnosing and resolving networking and communications problems in field, tactical, or other mission-critical environments.

  • Strong practical networking knowledge across the areas described above, including packet capture and analysis.

  • Working experience with video streaming protocols and codecs (RTSP, RTP/UDP, SRT, MPEG-TS, WebRTC, HLS; H.264/H.265) and with troubleshooting video delivery over bandwidth-constrained links.

  • Proficiency administering and troubleshooting Linux systems from the command line.

  • Working knowledge of RF communications and at least one beyond-line-of-sight, satellite, or tactical communications environment.

  • Ability to read and interpret technical documentation, network diagrams, configurations, and standard operating procedures.

  • Experience briefing, training, or supporting military, government, or defense customers.

  • Strong problem-solving, field judgment, and communication skills.

  • Ability to travel a minimum of 25%.

  • Relevant field, military, technical, or operational experience may substitute for an engineering degree.

Preferred

  • Prior Mission Operations, Field Operations, Program Support, Field Service, Network Operations, or Technical Pre-Sales experience.

  • Experience supporting large-scale government evaluations, operational tests, field exercises, or deployed communications missions.

  • Experience with satellite communications, tactical or mesh networking, or RF systems in austere environments.

  • Familiarity with Somewear Labs' platforms or similar technologies.

On a typical day you might walk a venue coordinator in Melbourne through your room and AV requirements in the morning, lock catering numbers against the live registration count and follow up two presenter confirmations with the academic team after lunch, and update the run sheet and brief the on-ground leads before you log off.

About Contour

We started in 2020 with a handful of students and a belief that great education should not be out of reach. Today we operate across three brands with 8,000+ students and 425+ team members: roughly 100 in India and 325 onshore in Australia. The India team runs publishing, student experience, CRM and technology, operations, and people and culture, and this role sits with the events function that delivers Contour's event calendar across Australia.

A great event looks effortless to the family walking in. Someone has to be the reason it looks that way.

About This Role

You are the dedicated project manager behind Contour's events. The calendar runs from full exam simulation days for hundreds of students to revision lecture series selling thousands of tickets across Victoria and Queensland, with parent workshops and online sessions in between. You take each one from first brief to post-event review: timeline, venue, suppliers, registration milestones, comms deadlines, run sheet, event-day coordination, wrap-up.

You report to the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO). The CMO owns marketing strategy and the onshore event-day call when someone must be in the room. Everything else about how events get planned and delivered is yours. Marketing owns promotion, creative, and the registration campaigns. Academics owns session content and who presents it. Operations owns student data and check-in technology. On event day, teams on the ground in Australia execute in the room. The plan that ties them together, the dates they all work to, and the accountability for the day landing well: those are yours.

Two qualities separate a strong hire from an average one here. First, you think in dependencies: you see that catering numbers hang off registration close, which hangs off a reminder email, which hangs off a presenter confirming a title, and you fix the weak link three weeks early instead of discovering it three days out. Second, you follow up without souring relationships: you ask specifically, escalate when twice was enough, and people still enjoy working with you.

One more reality worth naming: you will rarely be in the room. You run events from India that are delivered in Australia, which means your plans, run sheets, and briefings have to be strong enough that the day runs without you standing in it.

You start as the sole dedicated event project manager, plugged into established marketing, academic, operations, and student experience teams. The calendar has grown faster than the way it is run: the biggest series now sell out lecture theatres, and until now no single person has owned how events get delivered. You build that playbook: the standard project plan, the run sheet format, the review loop that makes each event sharper than the last.

By the end of month three, you will have taken at least one major event from brief through delivery to review, built the project plan and run sheet templates the team reuses, and mapped the full calendar with owners, dates, and dependencies visible to everyone involved. What you build in those months will run every event Contour delivers after them.

Where the Work Lives

  • monday.com: project plans and task ownership live here. Keeping status current is how a remote team knows an event is on track without asking.

  • Google Sheets: run sheets, attendee lists, and event-day logistics. The people delivering the day work from your latest version, so document discipline is part of the job.

  • Eventbrite: registrations and ticketing. You watch the numbers daily because rooms, catering, and comms decisions all key off them.

  • HubSpot: student and guardian event comms run through it, alongside the lifecycle comms team.

  • Slack: where cross-team, cross-timezone coordination happens, in writing.

What You Will Do

  • Own each event end to end.Scope, timeline, suppliers, delivery, invoices, review: nothing about the event is someone else's problem.

  • Build and drive the project plan.Every task with an owner, a date, and a dependency in monday.com. When something slips, you catch it while there is still room to re-sequence.

  • Keep the full event calendar visible.Every event, owner, and key date in one place in monday.com, so anyone can see what's coming without asking you.

  • Coordinate Marketing, Academics, and Operations.Registration launches, presenter confirmations, resource handovers, comms milestones: you set the dates and hold every team to them.

  • Lock venues and suppliers.Room requirements, AV, catering, printing, signage: briefed clearly, confirmed in writing, and settled before their cutoffs.

  • Run registrations as a control signal.Work with the digital team on ticket setup in Eventbrite, track numbers daily, and trigger capacity, waitlist, and extra-session calls in good time, because 850 registrations against 760 seats is a problem you want weeks of notice on, not days.

  • Write the run sheet and brief the day.Minute by minute, with named owners for every stage, and briefings that leave the teams in the room certain of their part.

  • Close the loop.Attendance data, feedback, supplier invoices, a short post-event report, and fixes carried into the next plan.

If a better tool exists for something we are doing manually, make the case and we will back it.


Requirements

What You Need

  • 4 to 6 years delivering projects or events where you held the whole timeline, not a slice of it

  • You have delivered work that depended on people who did not report to you, and it landed anyway

  • Comfortable chasing and escalating. A quiet slip three weeks out becomes an event-day crisis, so persistence here is method, not personality, and the people you chase still want to work with you again.

  • Writing that lands exactly as intended. Your documents are how a remote coordinator directs a live day, so they carry more weight than they would in an office

  • Clean document and data habits: plans, lists, and versions other people can trust without checking with you

  • Comfortable working across the India and Australia time difference, with the flexibility to be on deck when events go live

Nice to Have

  • You have run an event remotely, delivered in a city or country you were not in

  • Events for education, exams, or student and family audiences

  • Hands-on with monday.com, Eventbrite, or HubSpot

  • Negotiating with venues and suppliers

The Kind of People Who Thrive Here
The people who do well here see a gap and close it without being asked, holding the bar even when the clock is short. They give a direct read on the work in front of them, including when it's wrong, and when their own idea doesn't hold up, they say so and bring a better one. They build something that keeps running after they step back. Problems here don't show up on schedule or in the same shape twice, and they'd rather make the right call on limited information than let something break while they wait for a sign-off. That's the job. They name the blocker and the ask the moment they have it, on a call or a text, because decisions get made on the information you bring.

Contour's current cluster heads started as team leads. The path from operator to leader is real here.

What Good Looks Like

  • Nothing slips silently:every at-risk date is flagged with a re-plan attached, not just an apology.

  • The day runs off the document:venue and floor teams execute from your run sheet without needing you on the phone every ten minutes.

  • Stakeholders answer you:your asks are specific, dated, and easy to action, so people respond instead of stalling.

  • Every event beats the last:reviews turn into changes in the next plan, not a document nobody opens.


Benefits

Fully remote, anywhere in India. The events themselves happen in Australia; you coordinate them from wherever you are, and onshore teams deliver on the day. Compensation details shared early in the hiring process. After you apply: a short screen, a practical planning task, then a culture conversation with our People team, and a final interview with the Chief Marketing Officer, in about four weeks.

Apply with a CV and one paragraph on the most complex event or project you have delivered, and the moment it nearly went wrong.

jobs.description:
OptionMetrics, headquartered in New York, NY. is a dynamic and innovative technology company, a trusted provider of financial information and research derived from the option markets. We are at the forefront of developing solutions that empower businesses. Our commitment to excellence, coupled with a collaborative, forward-thinking culture, has made us the preferred choice for top-tier talent. Our data and analytics models are utilized by over 350 investment banks, hedge funds, asset management firms, and academic institutions globally, solidifying our position as a leader in the industry.

Are you ready to own the cloud foundation behind a market-leading financial data business? At OptionMetrics, we're looking for a Senior Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer to own our multi-account AWS environment, our client-facing file-delivery platform, the deployment pipelines and scheduled workflows that ship our data, and the security controls around all of it. Our clients and internal teams depend on this infrastructure every day. You'll keep it reliable, automate how it runs, and leave it better documented than you found it.

You'll report to the Head of IT Operations and work closely with Engineering, Product, Sales and Customer Support.

What You'll Own:

    Client file delivery (CrushFTP): Production, test and DMZ environments on autoscaling and S3, client and support account provisioning, and operating the legacy platform through its retirement.

    AWS multi-account foundation: Organizations, SSO and IAM, the Transit Gateway hub-and-spoke network, and the migration of workloads off the main account.

    TLS and certificates: A full certificate inventory, auto-renewing ACM certificates, and alerting on expiring or mismatched certificates across every domain.

    Edge and application security: Cloudflare and AWS WAF rules, rate limiting, bot mitigation, and incident response for customer-facing applications.

    DevOps and release engineering: CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, TeamCity), deployments to production and non-production environments, and release plans for every production change.

    Workflow automation and monitoring: Our scheduled data workflows (Stonebranch/OpsWise), plus monitoring, alerting and on-call (Site24x7, Opsgenie) for business-critical jobs and services.

    Infrastructure as Code: Terraform and GitHub Actions with OIDC-based deployment, a sandbox account, and code-reviewed changes.

    Cost and compliance: Cost reporting, tag enforcement with AWS Config, and CrowdStrike coverage and access audits.

What You'll Do:

    Design, build and operate highly available AWS infrastructure across dev, test, prod and DMZ accounts.

    Plan and run production changes with a published change notice covering scope, impact, rollback and confirmation.

    Perform and oversee deployments to production and non-production environments, with a release plan, a rollback path and a Jira record for each.

    Build, maintain and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines, and help development teams ship safely and repeatably.

    Monitor and tune business-critical scheduled workflows, troubleshoot failures, and drive failed jobs to root cause through the weekly failure review.

    Build monitoring, alerting, consolidated metrics and logs that give stakeholders a clear view of system and workflow health.

    Respond to infrastructure and security incidents: contain first, then find the root cause and document it in Jira.

    Turn repeated manual work into automation using scripts, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure as Code and AI tooling.

    Apply least privilege to every access request: expiring SSO roles, and no long-lived keys without a documented use case.

    Write and maintain runbooks, architecture and network diagrams, and Confluence standards for everything you own, including legacy systems.

    Keep Jira current: every ticket you own shows a status, a blocker or a next step, updated at least every two weeks.

    Take ad-hoc requests from Sales, Support and Product. Clarify the need, commit to a date, and deliver.

    Coach junior engineers and hand off repeatable work to them with written runbooks.

How We Work:

    Disagree, then commit. Push back with evidence. Once a decision is made, deliver it as agreed, or agree an alternative in writing.

    Respect for colleagues. Criticize the problem, not the people or teams involved, in every channel.

    Stay calm when escalated. Answer with status and next steps.

    Make your work visible. Post a daily written standup update (Shipped / Next / Blockers) and take part in team rituals.

    Review every change. Production changes go through code review, including urgent ones.

    Own the whole job. Documentation, legacy systems and request handling are part of the role, not a distraction from it.

Skills You'll Need:

    6+ years in cloud or infrastructure engineering, including 4+ years running production AWS.

    Deep AWS experience: VPC, Transit Gateway, Client VPN, IAM, SSO, Organizations, ELB/ALB/NLB, ACM, EC2 Auto Scaling, S3, AWS Config and CloudTrail.

    Strong Linux administration skills.

    Hands-on DevOps experience: CI/CD pipelines, release management, and supporting development teams through deployments.

    Experience running a job scheduler or workflow automation platform (Stonebranch/OpsWise, Control-M, Airflow or similar) and troubleshooting failed pipelines.

    Production experience with Terraform and CI/CD in GitHub Actions, including OIDC.

    Solid grounding in TLS/PKI, DNS (Route53 and external providers) and file transfer over FTP, FTPS, SFTP, SSH and HTTP/HTTPS.

    A security mindset: least privilege, WAF and rate limiting, and incident response.

    Scripting in Python or Bash.

    A track record of delivering on commitments in an environment with frequent interruptions.

Skills You'll Need:

What Will Make You Stand Out:

The role combines hands-on strategic consulting delivery, commercial leadership, and team building, with full accountability for revenue generation, client development, and the growth of the consultancy business line within a broader Price Reporting Agency (PRA) environment.

The successful candidate will act as the principal consultancy lead for our global business, with direct responsibility and accountability in driving sales and revenue generation in Forest product consultancy, working closely with global analysts and commercial teams to develop and deliver high-impact client solutions.

Specifically, you will generate business development opportunities, lead and deliver all strategy and market-based consultancy projects that include tailored market overviews and outlooks, feasibility assessments and analysis, cost benchmarking and competitiveness analysis, supply-chain mapping, go-to-market and commercial due diligence advisory, packaging value chain strategy and circular economy insights, and other bespoke engagements.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the principal lead for all forest products consultancy engagements across pulp, paper, and packaging markets globally
  • Winning, executing, and project managing (both independently and in collaboration with our delivery teams and business partners) a range of strategic and market-based consultancy projects in the forest products space.
  • Managing consultancy deliverables (self-sufficiently and managing others) that are robust, accurate, and well-researched and project managing resources utilising modelling, data collection, and research interview techniques
  • Position the Fastmarkets consultancy practice as a credible and leading alternative to established rival firms
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing US consultancy team
  • Establish scalable processes, frameworks, and methodologies for consultancy delivery
  • Foster a high-performance, client-focused consulting culture
  • Lead the development of market insights, reports, and client-facing thought leadership
  • Translate complex market dynamics into actionable commercial strategies for clients
  • Own and drive consultancy sales and revenue growth across North America and global accounts
  • Identify, develop, and convert new consultancy opportunities with existing PRA and external clients

  • Work closely with commercial and account teams to integrate consultancy offerings into broader client relationships
  • Developing and building existing customer relationships and acquiring new consultancy customers, as well as repeat/retainer business
  • Forecasting and CRM reporting
  • Represent the business externally at industry events, client presentations, and conferences
  • Utilise professional network to surface opportunities and to source independent contractors to support the delivery of engagements.

We recruit talented, dynamic people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, all united by a belief in our mission to provide the world’s leading and most trusted price reporting, events, and intelligence service for the markets we serve. We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to creating a fully inclusive workplace, where everyone feels able to participate and contribute meaningfully.

If you are open-minded, curious, resilient, solutions-oriented and committed to promoting equality, then read on.

KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

We are looking for an individual who is highly motivated, driven, and have a passion to be part of a fast-paced, successful team. Being a strong team player is also important as well as someone who is happy to work flexibly.

Experience and skills required

  • A seasoned individual with consulting experience in Forest product consultancy, proven business development and research
  • Proven experience in a top-tier consulting firm (e.g. McKinsey, BCG, Bain) or specialist commodities consultancy
  • Demonstrated experience in building or scaling a consulting practice or business line in the Forest products space
  • Deep knowledge of global pulp, paper, and packaging markets and value chains
  • Strong track record of leading client-facing advisory engagements at a senior level
  • Experience in complex solution selling and project execution/management involving single-client consultancy services work
  • Fluent in English, a second language preferred
  • Flexibility and willingness to travel when required
  • An already established client and industry contact network would be desirable
  • Self-starter and ‘hunter’ mentality with strong personal drive is essential, with the ability to thrive in a multitasking environment
  • Accountable and performance-driven
  • Effective communication in person, on the phone, in writing and online
  • Effective and amiable team player keen on making clients, project members, and colleagues happy while achieving ambitious objectives.

This is a rare opportunity to build and lead a global forest products consulting practice within a leading commodities intelligence organisation. The role offers significant autonomy to shape strategy, develop a high-performing team, and drive meaningful commercial growth, while competing directly with the world’s leading consulting and specialist advisory firms.

If you're excited about the role but your experience, skills or qualifications don't perfectly align, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Our Values

Fastmarkets people come from all different walks of life. It’s this mix of brilliant personalities, experiences and insights that gives us that warm, open, and friendly culture you can feel as soon as you meet us. But however wonderfully different we all are, there are six things we all have in common – and they form our Fastmarkets values.

Created by our own employees to reflect some of the personal traits that Fastmarkets people have, our values are key to what makes our culture unique. They reflect who each of us are and they're embedded in everything we do. Our values are:

  • METRICS DRIVEN. We use insights to improve our customers’ experience and our business performance
  • ACCOUNTABLE. We are accountable to ourselves and those we work with: we keep our promises and get things done
  • GROWTH MINDSET. This value enables us to be nimble to the changing realities and operate with a sense of urgency
  • INCLUSIVE. We are inclusive and respectful, celebrating each of us and giving everyone a deep sense of belonging with the desire to bring their best self to work every day.
  • CUSTOMER CENTRIC. We are customer-centric in all that we do
  • COLLABORATIVE. We are collaborative, able to work across teams and capitalise on the diversity of intellect, perspectives, and experiences.

• Pennsylvania

• Texas*

jobs.excerpt: Why this role existsK0rdent AI is the orchestration layer that turns raw, disaggregated GPU infrastructure into a multi-tenant, production-ready AI cloud — without locking companies into a single hyperscaler or hardware vendor.
jobs.description:
Why this role exists

K0rdent AI is the orchestration layer that turns raw, disaggregated GPU infrastructure into a multi-tenant, production-ready AI cloud — without locking companies into a single hyperscaler or hardware vendor. We sell accelerated compute: GPU clusters, bare metal, and managed AI infrastructure to Neoclouds, AI-native startups, enterprise AI teams, research labs, and sovereign/regulated buyers. These are technical, high-value, long-cycle deals where the sale is won or lost on credibility: whether we can architect the right cluster, model the real TCO, prove performance, and de-risk a customer's move onto our platform.

This person owns the technical win. They build and lead the sales engineering function that turns "interested" into signed, multi-year committed-capacity contracts, and they set the pre-sales bar as we scale headcount and deal volume.

This is not a demo-jockey role. We need someone who has genuinely stood up training and inference workloads, argued interconnect topology with a customer's ML infra lead, and closed large deals with cycles measured in quarters, not weeks.

What you'll own

Lead and build the SE / Solutions Architect team

  • Hire, coach, and retain a team of sales engineers and solutions architects; define the pre-sales operating model as the org scales.

  • Build the reusable machinery: discovery frameworks, reference architectures, TCO/benchmark models, POV playbooks, demo and benchmark environments, RFP response libraries.

  • Set and hold a technical quality bar across the team; run enablement so every SE can speak credibly to GPU architecture, networking, and orchestration.

Own the technical win in large, complex deals

  • Partner with Account Executives as the technical lead on strategic and enterprise opportunities from discovery through technical close.

  • Run qualification with a real methodology (MEDDPICC or equivalent) — surface the economic buyer, decision criteria, and the technical champion, and build the win plan around them.

  • Architect solutions across compute, networking, storage, and orchestration; produce sizing, capacity plans, and TCO comparisons vs. hyperscalers and self-build.

  • Design and drive POCs/POVs: define success criteria up front, run benchmarks, and convert results into commercial momentum.

Be the Technical voice of the Customer internally

  • Feed structured product and capacity requirements back to product, platform, and supply/capacity planning.

  • Work alongside the NVIDIA field and partner ecosystem (Cloud Partner program, reference architectures, joint pursuits) to strengthen deals.

  • Influence roadmap and packaging based on what you learn in the field.

Required:

Real, hands-on AI/ML infrastructure experience

  • You have actually run or stood up ML workloads — distributed training and/or production inference — not just talked about them.

  • Practical fluency in the training and inference lifecycle: data pipelines, distributed training (multi-node/multi-GPU), fine-tuning, and serving; you understand where bottlenecks actually live (interconnect, memory bandwidth, I/O, scheduling).

  • Comfortable in the frameworks and tooling customers use — PyTorch and the surrounding ecosystem (e.g., NCCL, CUDA-level concepts, containers, schedulers).

Deep knowledge of the NVIDIA platform and GPU products

  • Current on the NVIDIA compute stack across the Hopper and Blackwell generations (e.g., H100/H200, GB200 NVL72 / B200-class systems, Grace-Hopper superchips) and the reference-system families (DGX, HGX, MGX); aware of what's coming next-generation.

  • Networking fluency: NVLink/NVSwitch domains, InfiniBand (Quantum) vs. Spectrum-X Ethernet fabrics, RDMA/RoCE, DPUs — and why fabric choice makes or breaks large training clusters.

  • Software and platform layer: NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NIM, NeMo, Triton / TensorRT-LLM, Base Command, Run:ai / GPU orchestration, and the NGC ecosystem.

  • Understands the NVIDIA Cloud Partner motion and how to co-sell with NVIDIA.

Enterprise sales engineering on long, high-value cycles

  • Track record supporting complex B2B deals with cycles of 6–18+ months and large ACV/TCV, ideally including multi-year committed-capacity or reserved-capacity structures.

  • Skilled at multi-stakeholder navigation — ML/infra leads, platform engineering, procurement, finance, security, and executive sponsors.

  • Can build and defend a TCO/ROI model against hyperscaler and on-prem alternatives, and translate performance benchmarks into commercial value.

Proven team leadership

  • Has hired, developed, and led a sales engineering / solutions architecture team (or clearly demonstrated the readiness to), including building process and enablement from a light or greenfield starting point.

  • Player-coach mindset: still credible in the room on the hardest deals, while scaling others to do the same.

Strongly preferred

  • Experience selling GPU cloud, HPC, or specialized infrastructure — ideally at a NeoCloud / GPU-cloud provider, hyperscaler AI org, or accelerated-hardware vendor.

  • Hands-on with cloud-native and cluster orchestration for AI: Kubernetes (and GPU operators / device plugins), Slurm, and multi-cluster management approaches; familiarity with virtualized GPU / KubeVirt-style patterns is a plus.

  • Storage-for-AI literacy — high-throughput parallel/object storage and its role in training pipelines.

  • Experience with data center economics and constraints: power, cooling, rack density, and how capacity availability shapes deals.

  • Exposure to sovereign, regulated, or government AI buyers.

What does Mirantis offer you?

  • Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry;
  • Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies;
  • Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation;
  • Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued;
  • Professional development and training;
  • Attend conferences and working groups;
  • Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks;
  • Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan.

We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewThe Staff, Lease Administration Analyst role requires a thorough understanding of lease documents as well as integrating lease documents on behalf of The RMR Group Inc.
jobs.description:
Overview

The Staff, Lease Administration Analyst role requires a thorough understanding of lease documents as well as integrating lease documents on behalf of The RMR Group Inc. and its subsidiaries, three publicly traded affiliated entities and a privately held fund, into a centralized database which is the foundation of reporting analysis utilized by the broader organization. This role requires the candidate to accurately discern and abstract lease documents, as well as ensuring the financial terms of the deal are accurately represented in Yardi, the system of record, to ensure accurate reporting for the broader organization. This role requires close coordination with various business functions of Accounting, Asset Management, Asset Services and Legal departments.

Responsibilities

  • Integrate Executed Deals received and incorporate vital data within the Yardi application.
  • Abstract critical lease terms, including recovery clauses, for new Leases, Lease Amendments, Lease Terminations, Assignments and other lease documents within Yardi.
    • Review and approve of lease abstractions processed by third-party for Executed Deals.
    • Abstractions must provide a heightened focus on properly capturing Revenue Recognition items and Encumbrance data to ensure effective reporting.
  • Review and approve of lease abstractions processed by third-party for Acquisition related deals.
  • Actively assess the impact of Revenue Recognition items which impact Straight-Line Rent Calculations. Collaborate and discuss Revenue Recognition items with Accounting Manager and Manager, Lease Administration to ensure compliance with established SOX 404 Narratives.
  • Maintain open communication with Real Estate Services regarding the building square footage modifications, unit changes, lease document status, move-in/out forms, major tenant information, and other open portfolio issues.
  • Work with Real Estate Services monthly to identify tenants in Holdover status.
  • Create and execute the approval process and posting of monthly Recurring Charges, as well as any miscellaneous billings/adjustments associated with Recurring Charges.
  • Calculate Consumer Price Index (CPI) Adjustments as they become due on a monthly basis.
  • Coordinate and process reconciliation of accounts which may have outstanding A/R issues (Government CPI for example).
  • Assist with the calculation and booking of Percentage Rent and Sub-Rent Receivable Income, when applicable.
  • Work with Records Management Administrators to resolve discrepancies relating to tenant lease files to ensure documents are properly reflected in the Digital Lease Library.
  • Assist with new acquisitions by setting up core Tenant information in Yardi.
  • Assist with capital recycling efforts as they arise by supporting the team with the Estoppel Management process.
  • Assist with the integration of new annual escrows for Operating Expenses and Taxes. Maintain Recovery Clause data and accurate Tenant base amount information within Yardi and the Excel based Templates in Progress on a daily basis throughout the year.
  • Discuss lease document status, questions and/or open issues with the Manager and follow up with Real Estate Services, Asset Management or Accounting as the need arises.
  • As part of the monthly close process, assist with reconciliation of Yardi and Executed deals in RMR Reporting.
  • Perform special projects as needed, such as assist with internal and external audit requests, and provide support for the Accounting, Legal, Real Estate Services and Asset Management departments.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Proficiency with accounting software package (Yardi) preferred. Proficiency with Excel and other Microsoft applications.
  • This position requires keen attention to detail, self-motivation, flexibility, a solution mindset and excellent organizational and interpersonal skills.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills are required.
  • Overall knowledge and interest in the commercial real estate industry is critical to success in this position. Working knowledge of leases is a plus.
  • Demonstrates ability to work with evolving technologies and business applications, including AI-assisted tools, to support research, data validation, workflow efficiency and process improvement.
  • 3+ years of commercial real estate lease administration experience, knowledge of standard and non-standard lease components. Ability to interpret complex retail and commercial lease language and an understanding of the accounting requirements of leases is essential.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative and results driven environment with the ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines.

Total Rewards

The RMR Group offers an extensive total rewards package to ensure that your benefits align with your needs. Employees who work at least 21 hours per week are eligible to participate in The RMR Group’s benefits plans, including:

  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Life & Disability Insurance
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) & Flexible Spending Plans (FSA)
  • 401(k) Plan with Employer Match
  • Holidays, Vacation & Sick Time
  • Parental Leave
  • Tuition Assistance
  • Matching Gift Program
  • Wide Array of Voluntary, Employee-Paid Benefits to choose from including Critical Illness & Accident Insurance, Identity Theft Protection & Pet Insurance

The estimated base compensation range for this position is $70,000 to $90,000 per year. RMR considers several components including an individual's skills, qualifications, experience, internal equity, and market data.

Company Overview

The RMR Group (Nasdaq: RMR) is a leading U.S. alternative asset management company, unique for its focus on commercial real estate (CRE) and related businesses. RMR’s vertical integration is strengthened by over 800 real estate professionals in more than 30 offices nationwide who manage over $37 billion in assets under management and leverage 40 years of institutional experience in buying, selling, financing and operating CRE. RMR benefits from a scalable platform, a deep and experienced management team, and a diversity of real estate strategies across its clients. RMR has been recognized by The Boston Globe as a “Top Place to Work”, by the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) as an “ENERGY STAR Partner of the Year” and ranked by the Building Owners and Managers Association (BOMA) as having one of the highest number of BOMA 360 designated properties in its portfolio. RMR is headquartered in Newton, MA and was founded in 1986.

RMR’s mission is to create long term value for our clients by managing their investments and assets “like we own it” – an approach that consistently and repeatedly generates opportunities for all our employees, investors and stakeholders. We are guided by six core values:

  • Integrity at Our Core.
  • Perform Passionately and Effectively.
  • Inspired Thinking.
  • Like We Own It.
  • Power of We.
  • Mutual Respect.

Visit our website to learn more about what makes The RMR Group a rewarding place to build a career.

Follow RMR on LinkedIn and Instagram @thermrgroup.

As an Escrow Closer, you will assist with the escrow closing process, including compliance with lender instructions, title insurance requirements, and other written instructions.   • Understand the escrow process to determine what steps need to be taken to properly cure e title of properties pursuant to the conditions called for in the real estate contract and/or lender instructions.
  • Prepare all closing documents necessary to ensure title insurance is issued at closing.
  • Secure all documents (corrective and others) that may be required for the issuance of title insurance.
  • Single point of contact for borrowers, loan officers, processors and others.
  • Assist customers and clients with closing related questions.
  • Prior to disbursement, confirm all funds are collected, all appropriate documents are checked for accuracy, signatures are collected, and acknowledgements and legal descriptions are correct.
  • Collect all taxes due, HOA dues, and any delinquencies and/or principal and interest.
  • Verify against the closing disclosure or settlement that all disbursements have been paid correctly.
  • Prior to recording, verify all legal documents for correct acknowledgements, legal, and lien information.
  • Manage and develop client relationships to ensure future real estate closing transactions.

  • A creative problem solver: you have a proven track record of thinking “outside the box” to solve complicated problems. You have a global perspective, sound business judgment, and are truth-seeking in your solutioning and decisioning. You are also willing to roll up your sleeves and do whatever it takes to solve the problem.

You’re a natural planner and organizer, and can effectively manage bandwidth and resources inside and outside your organization to bring about the successful completion of key objectives and initiatives.

  • Excellent customer service skills are required, including the ability to interact professionally and knowledgeably with Borrowers, Loan officers, Processors, and Underwriters
  • Familiarity with Refinance transactions and requirements
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Knowledge of the escrow process and mortgage lending regulations

jobs.description:
The Corporate Development Manager will own the financial evaluation and execution of two types of transactions: acquisitions of existing medspa practices generating $2–20M in annual revenue, and "acqui-hire" transactions that bring independent providers into our new and existing clinics. You will be the primary analytical engine behind every deal, from first look through close, determining whether an opportunity is attractive, building a defensible view of adjusted EBITDA or provider-level economics, and supporting leadership in valuation and negotiation discussions with practice owners and providers. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both the rigor of financial analysis and the pace of live deals.

Key Responsibilities

Deal screening and evaluation
• Review inbound and outbound opportunities, quickly assessing fit against our acquisition criteria (market, service mix, provider base, growth potential, and financial profile)
• Prepare concise investment memos and recommendations for leadership on whether to pursue, pass, or restructure a deal
• Build and maintain a pipeline tracker and deal database
Financial analysis and quality of earnings
• Analyze practice financials, including P&Ls, tax returns, bank statements, and point-of-sale/EMR data, often from owners with limited financial reporting
• Build adjusted EBITDA bridges, normalizing for owner compensation, medical director arrangements, provider compensation, one-time and personal expenses, related-party rent, and non-recurring revenue
• Analyze key operating metrics such as revenue by service line, provider productivity, patient retention and rebooking rates, membership revenue, product and injectable margins, and customer concentration
• Coordinate with third-party quality-of-earnings providers, accountants, and attorneys as needed

Valuation and deal structuring
• Develop valuation models using EBITDA multiples, comparable transactions, and DCF where appropriate
• Model deal structures including cash at close, seller notes, earnouts, rollover equity, and provider retention incentives
• Prepare materials to support leadership in valuation discussions and negotiations with sellers

Provider Acqui-hires (independent providers)
• Identify and evaluate independent injectors, aestheticians, and other providers operating in salon suites or similar settings as candidates to join our clinics
• Assess each provider's book of business, including revenue, service mix, client count, rebooking and retention rates, pricing, and how much of the client base is likely to follow them
• Build provider-level economic models comparing their current earnings to our compensation structure, and project the incremental revenue and contribution to the receiving clinic
• Structure offers such as sign-on or book-of-business payments, earnouts tied to client retention, guaranteed compensation periods, and retention incentives
• Verify licensing, scope of practice, and supervision requirements, and assess fit with the receiving clinic's capacity, service menu, and team
• Partner with clinic leadership on onboarding and client transition plans, and track retention and productivity against the original business case

Diligence and closing
• Manage the financial diligence process, including data requests, document review, and issue tracking
• Help identify operational, regulatory, and integration risks (e.g., provider licensing and scope of practice, medical director and ownership structure requirements, key-person dependence)
• Support LOI drafting and the path to close alongside legal counsel

Post-close support
• Track acquired practice and acqui-hired provider performance against the investment case
• Help refine acquisition criteria and underwriting assumptions based on results

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required
• 3–5 years of experience in private equity, investment banking, transaction advisory/quality of earnings, corporate development, or a comparable finance role
• Hands-on experience building adjusted EBITDA analyses and valuation models for small and lower-middle-market businesses (roughly $2–10M in revenue)
• Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills
• Ability to evaluate individual provider economics and client portability, not just practice-level financials
• Ability to work with incomplete or messy financial data and turn it into clear, defensible conclusions
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present recommendations to senior leadership
• High degree of ownership, judgment, and ability to manage multiple deals at once

Preferred
• Private equity experience, particularly with add-on acquisitions or buy-and-build strategies
• Experience in healthcare services, multi-site consumer services, or franchise businesses; medical aesthetics experience is a strong plus
• Familiarity with the salon-suite model or experience recruiting and valuing producer-based talent (e.g., providers, advisors, stylists)
• Undergraduate degree in Business, Accounting, or Finance preferred
• MBA a plus
• Familiarity with healthcare transaction considerations such as MSO structures and corporate practice of medicine rules

Physical Requirements
• Ability to perform computer-based work for extended periods.
• Ability to communicate effectively via phone, video conference, and written communications.
• Ability to use standard office equipment.
• Ability to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Benefits

We offer a competitive benefits package designed to support your health, well-being, and financial future. Team members enjoy generous employee and Friends & Family discounts, and the opportunity to work alongside a talented and supportive team. Benefits also include paid holidays and a 401(k) plan with company match.
Eligible full-time employees (24+ hours per week) have access to medical, dental, and vision coverage; Health Savings Accounts (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA); company-paid life insurance; voluntary supplemental insurance options; and a comprehensive Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

jobs.description:
In short

We are building a HuggingFace / npm for ontologies. Ontologies are what gives data meaning – the new wave of AI applications needs them badly. We capture this wave.

We are looking for a student or junior community enthusiast to join our team as a Junior Developer Advocate. You don’t need years of experience or an impressive resume. We care about your curiosity, drive, and willingness to learn. Your focus will be supporting our developer advocacy efforts: helping us engage the community, create content, and get our open-source software into the hands of AI & data developers.

Fully remote within the EU/EFTA, some travel, small team, lots of ownership.

What you’ll do

You will work alongside a Community & Ecosystem Lead and core team to help build and nurture our developer community. You’ll get hands-on mentorship while having real ownership over your tasks. Depending on your strengths and interests, you’ll help us:

  • Organize tutorials / workshops at developer, technical, or scientific conferences

  • Talk to OSS communities – understand their needs, get partnerships

  • Make upstream contributions to OSS projects

  • Write tutorials and editorial content

  • Engage the community via social media and other channels (e.g., Discord)

  • Maintain our relations with key partners (e.g., content publishers, software companies)

  • Tell the dev team what the community really needs – what features unlock new use cases, for example

Who are we looking for

Rigid requirements (MUST have):

  • Fluent in English.

  • Living in the EU or EFTA.

  • Able to travel.

What we will look for (you don’t need to tick all boxes):

  • Good public speaker, experience in giving talks at technical or scientific conferences

  • Can code, at least to a degree to be able to teach people basic programming

  • Familiar with the open-source ecosystem (track record of OSS contributions preferred)

  • Good writing skills, preferably demonstrated with blog posts, research papers, or other content

  • Experience with operating social media profiles (especially engaging communities, not just blasting corporate propaganda)

  • Experience in organizing physical events

  • Very familiar with the data & AI spaces (e.g., agents, analytics, databases, graph analytics, ontologies)

  • Experience building or growing a technical community

NOT needed:

  • Formal education or an impressive resume. We are looking for people at all experience levels.

  • Speaking Polish – we speak English only!

  • Experience with ontologies – we can quickly teach you that, but if you know them, it’s a plus.

What can we give you

  • Work on high-visibility open-source projects with direct ownership over your tasks and mentorship from senior engineers.

  • Travel: scientific and technical conferences.

  • Equity on top of the base salary.

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Fully remote work.

  • Negotiable type of contract.

  • Competitive salary – strongly dependent on your experience level and motivation.

  • Regular team integrations (physical and virtual)

How we work

We are a small team, where we strongly prefer to give each team member ownership of a particular topic. There is no bureaucratic process. If you want to talk to the CEO/CTO, just hit them up on chat.

We are remote-first. You can work any hours that are the most convenient to you.

Our team members come from open source communities, academia, and tech. It’s a place where you’ll have access to some very smart folks that are a pleasure to work with.

How to apply

Your resume is not our main focus – your work is. Please include links to your relevant work: OSS projects, organized community events, talks you gave, social media pages managed by you, scientific papers, or anything else that is relevant to interacting with communities.

You can put these links either in the resume, or in the dedicated application form field.

We build infrastructure software – the new generation of data products to be used by top companies worldwide. Our tech is built on deep R&D done in collaboration with international partners. The work is partially funded from EU grants.

jobs.description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

We’re looking for a fast, creative, forward-thinking professional who has a strong background in retention. You’re the right fit for this role if you are comfortable with figuring things out as you go, defaulting to action, and adapting to additional responsibilities. You’ll have a proven record of achieving your goals and the goals of your team.

  • Provide comprehensive, end-to-end support to our key partners, acting as a relationship manager. Employ proactive and reactive measures to ensure a "white glove" experience for our most valued payroll partners.

  • 3+ years of experience with innovative strategic partnerships for consumer-facing, web services, and SAAS products
  • Demonstrated capacity to anticipate partner needs, identify challenges proactively, and adapt to a fast-paced, evolving environment, all while sustaining a positive attitude.

  • Experience in developing and leveraging strategic insights to foster and/or improve business relationships

  • Fundamental Optimism: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.
